entries.name: @abstract
entries.summary: Marks a class or a method as abstract.

entries.name: @export
entries.summary: Mark the following property as exported (editable in the Inspector dock and saved to disk). To control the type of the exported property, use the type hint notation.

entries.name: @export_category
entries.summary: Define a new category for the following exported properties. This helps to organize properties in the Inspector dock.

entries.name: @export_color_no_alpha
entries.summary: Export a Color, Array[Color], or PackedColorArray property without allowing its transparency (Color.a) to be edited.

entries.name: @export_custom
entries.summary: Allows you to set a custom hint, hint string, and usage flags for the exported property. Note that there's no validation done in GDScript, it will just pass the parameters to the editor.

entries.name: @export_dir
entries.summary: Export a String, Array[String], or PackedStringArray property as a path to a directory. The path will be limited to the project folder and its subfolders.

entries.name: @export_enum
entries.summary: Export an int, String, Array[int], Array[String], PackedByteArray, PackedInt32Array, PackedInt64Array, or PackedStringArray property as an enumerated list of options (or an array of options).

entries.name: @export_exp_easing
entries.summary: Export a floating-point property with an easing editor widget. Additional hints can be provided to adjust the behavior of the widget.

entries.name: @export_file
entries.summary: Export a String, Array[String], or PackedStringArray property as a path to a file. The path will be limited to the project folder and its subfolders. See @export_global_file to allow picking from the entire filesystem.

entries.name: @export_file_path
entries.summary: Same as @export_file, except the file will be stored as a raw path. This means that it may become invalid when the file is moved. If you are exporting a Resource path, consider using @export_file instead.

entries.name: @export_flags
entries.summary: Export an integer property as a bit flag field. This allows to store several "checked" or true values with one property, and comfortably select them from the Inspector dock.

entries.name: @export_flags_2d_navigation
entries.summary: Export an integer property as a bit flag field for 2D navigation layers. The widget in the Inspector dock will use the layer names defined in ProjectSettings.layer_names/2d_navigation/layer_1.

entries.name: @export_flags_2d_physics
entries.summary: Export an integer property as a bit flag field for 2D physics layers. The widget in the Inspector dock will use the layer names defined in ProjectSettings.layer_names/2d_physics/layer_1.

entries.name: @export_flags_2d_render
entries.summary: Export an integer property as a bit flag field for 2D render layers. The widget in the Inspector dock will use the layer names defined in ProjectSettings.layer_names/2d_render/layer_1.

entries.name: @export_flags_3d_navigation
entries.summary: Export an integer property as a bit flag field for 3D navigation layers. The widget in the Inspector dock will use the layer names defined in ProjectSettings.layer_names/3d_navigation/layer_1.

entries.name: @export_flags_3d_physics
entries.summary: Export an integer property as a bit flag field for 3D physics layers. The widget in the Inspector dock will use the layer names defined in ProjectSettings.layer_names/3d_physics/layer_1.

entries.name: @export_flags_3d_render
entries.summary: Export an integer property as a bit flag field for 3D render layers. The widget in the Inspector dock will use the layer names defined in ProjectSettings.layer_names/3d_render/layer_1.

entries.name: @export_flags_avoidance
entries.summary: Export an integer property as a bit flag field for navigation avoidance layers. The widget in the Inspector dock will use the layer names defined in ProjectSettings.layer_names/avoidance/layer_1.

entries.name: @export_global_dir
entries.summary: Export a String, Array[String], or PackedStringArray property as an absolute path to a directory. The path can be picked from the entire filesystem. See @export_dir to limit it to the project folder and its subfolders.

entries.name: @export_global_file
entries.summary: Export a String, Array[String], or PackedStringArray property as an absolute path to a file. The path can be picked from the entire filesystem. See @export_file to limit it to the project folder and its subfolders.

entries.name: @export_group
entries.summary: Define a new group for the following exported properties. This helps to organize properties in the Inspector dock.

entries.name: @export_multiline
entries.summary: Export a String, Array[String], PackedStringArray, Dictionary or Array[Dictionary] property with a large TextEdit widget instead of a LineEdit.

entries.name: @export_node_path
entries.summary: Export a NodePath or Array[NodePath] property with a filter for allowed node types.

entries.name: @export_placeholder
entries.summary: Export a String, Array[String], or PackedStringArray property with a placeholder text displayed in the editor widget when no value is present.

entries.name: @export_range
entries.signature: @export_range(min: float, max: float, step: float = 1.0, extra_hints: String = "", ...) vararg
entries.summary: Export an int, float, Array[int], Array[float], PackedByteArray, PackedInt32Array, PackedInt64Array, PackedFloat32Array, or PackedFloat64Array property as a range value.

entries.name: @export_storage
entries.summary: Export a property with @GlobalScope.PROPERTY_USAGE_STORAGE flag. The property is not displayed in the editor, but it is serialized and stored in the scene or resource file. This can be useful for @tool scripts.

entries.name: @export_subgroup
entries.summary: Define a new subgroup for the following exported properties. This helps to organize properties in the Inspector dock. Subgroups work exactly like groups, except they need a parent group to exist. See @export_group.

entries.name: @export_tool_button
entries.summary: Export a Callable property as a clickable button with the label text. When the button is pressed, the callable is called.

entries.name: @GDScript
entries.summary: Built-in GDScript constants, functions, and annotations.

entries.name: @GlobalScope
entries.summary: Global scope constants and functions.

entries.name: @icon
entries.summary: Add a custom icon to the current script. The icon specified at icon_path is displayed in the Scene dock for every node of that class, as well as in various editor dialogs.

entries.name: @onready
entries.summary: Mark the following property as assigned when the Node is ready.

entries.name: @rpc
entries.signature: @rpc(mode: String = "authority", sync: String = "call_remote", transfer_mode: String = "reliable", transfer_channel: int = 0)
entries.summary: Mark the following method for remote procedure calls. See High-level multiplayer.

entries.name: @static_unload
entries.summary: Make a script with static variables to not persist after all references are lost. If the script is loaded again the static variables will revert to their default values.

entries.name: @tool
entries.summary: Mark the current script as a tool script, allowing it to be loaded and executed by the editor. See Running code in the editor.

entries.name: @warning_ignore
entries.summary: Mark the following statement to ignore the specified warning. See GDScript warning system.

entries.name: @warning_ignore_restore
entries.summary: Stops ignoring the listed warning types after @warning_ignore_start. Ignoring the specified warning types will be reset to Project Settings.

entries.name: @warning_ignore_start
entries.summary: Starts ignoring the listed warning types until the end of the file or the @warning_ignore_restore annotation with the given warning type.

entries.name: abs
entries.summary: Returns the absolute value of a Variant parameter x (i.e. non-negative value). Supported types: int, float, Vector2, Vector2i, Vector3, Vector3i, Vector4, Vector4i.

entries.name: absf
entries.summary: Returns the absolute value of float parameter x (i.e. positive value).

entries.name: absi
entries.summary: Returns the absolute value of int parameter x (i.e. positive value).

entries.name: AccessibilityServer
entries.summary: The AccessibilityServer singleton.

entries.name: acos
entries.summary: Returns the arc cosine of x in radians. Use to get the angle of cosine x. x will be clamped between -1.0 and 1.0 (inclusive), in order to prevent acos() from returning @GDScript.NAN.

entries.name: acosh
entries.summary: Returns the hyperbolic arc (also called inverse) cosine of x, returning a value in radians. Use it to get the angle from an angle's cosine in hyperbolic space if x is larger or equal to 1.

entries.name: angle_difference
entries.summary: Returns the difference between the two angles (in radians), in the range of [-PI, +PI]. When from and to are opposite, returns -PI if from is smaller than to, or PI otherwise.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D
entries.summary: Sprite node that contains multiple textures as frames to play for animation.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.animation
entries.summary: The current animation from the sprite_frames resource. If this value is changed, the frame counter and the frame_progress are reset.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.animation_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when animation changes.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.animation_finished
entries.summary: Emitted when the animation reaches the end, or the start if it is played in reverse. When the animation finishes, it pauses the playback.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.animation_looped
entries.summary: Emitted when the animation loops.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.autoplay
entries.summary: The key of the animation to play when the scene loads.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.centered
entries.summary: If true, texture will be centered.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.flip_h
entries.summary: If true, texture is flipped horizontally.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.flip_v
entries.summary: If true, texture is flipped vertically.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.frame
entries.summary: The displayed animation frame's index. Setting this property also resets frame_progress. If this is not desired, use set_frame_and_progress().

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.frame_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when frame changes.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.frame_progress
entries.summary: The progress value between 0.0 and 1.0 until the current frame transitions to the next frame. If the animation is playing backwards, the value transitions from 1.0 to 0.0.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.get_playing_speed
entries.summary: Returns the actual playing speed of current animation or 0 if not playing. This speed is the speed_scale property multiplied by custom_speed argument specified when calling the play() method.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.is_playing
entries.summary: Returns true if an animation is currently playing (even if speed_scale and/or custom_speed are 0).

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.offset
entries.summary: The texture's drawing offset.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.pause
entries.summary: Pauses the currently playing animation. The frame and frame_progress will be kept and calling play() or play_backwards() without arguments will resume the animation from the current playback position.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.play
entries.signature: void play(name: StringName = &"", custom_speed: float = 1.0, from_end: bool = false)
entries.summary: Plays the animation with key name. If custom_speed is negative and from_end is true, the animation will play backwards (which is equivalent to calling play_backwards()).

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.play_backwards
entries.summary: Plays the animation with key name in reverse.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.set_frame_and_progress
entries.summary: Sets frame and frame_progress to the given values. Unlike setting frame, this method does not reset the frame_progress to 0.0 implicitly.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.speed_scale
entries.summary: The speed scaling ratio. For example, if this value is 1, then the animation plays at normal speed. If it's 0.5, then it plays at half speed. If it's 2, then it plays at double speed.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.sprite_frames
entries.summary: The SpriteFrames resource containing the animation(s). Allows you the option to load, edit, clear, make unique and save the states of the SpriteFrames resource.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.sprite_frames_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when sprite_frames changes.

entries.name: AnimatedSprite2D.stop
entries.summary: Stops the currently playing animation. The animation position is reset to 0 and the custom_speed is reset to 1.0. See also pause().

entries.name: AnimationPlayer
entries.summary: A node used for animation playback.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.animation_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when a queued animation plays after the previous animation finished. See also queue().

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.animation_get_next
entries.summary: Returns the key of the animation which is queued to play after the animation_from animation.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.animation_set_next
entries.summary: Triggers the animation_to animation when the animation_from animation completes.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.assigned_animation
entries.summary: If playing, the current animation's key, otherwise, the animation last played. When set, this changes the animation, but will not play it unless already playing. See also current_animation.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.autoplay
entries.summary: The key of the animation to play when the scene loads.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.clear_queue
entries.summary: Clears all queued, unplayed animations.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.current_animation
entries.summary: The key of the currently playing animation. If no animation is playing, the property's value is an empty string. Changing this value does not restart the animation. See play() for more information on playing animations.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.current_animation_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when current_animation changes.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.current_animation_length
entries.summary: The length (in seconds) of the currently playing animation.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.current_animation_position
entries.summary: The position (in seconds) of the currently playing animation.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.get_blend_time
entries.signature: float get_blend_time(animation_from: StringName, animation_to: StringName) const
entries.summary: Returns the blend time (in seconds) between two animations, referenced by their keys.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.get_method_call_mode
entries.summary: Deprecated: Use AnimationMixer.callback_mode_method instead.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.get_playing_speed
entries.summary: Returns the actual playing speed of current animation or 0 if not playing. This speed is the speed_scale property multiplied by custom_speed argument specified when calling the play() method.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.get_process_callback
entries.summary: Deprecated: Use AnimationMixer.callback_mode_process instead.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.get_queue
entries.summary: Returns a list of the animation keys that are currently queued to play.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.get_root
entries.summary: Deprecated: Use AnimationMixer.root_node instead.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.get_section_end_time
entries.summary: Returns the end time of the section currently being played.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.get_section_start_time
entries.summary: Returns the start time of the section currently being played.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.has_section
entries.summary: Returns true if an animation is currently playing with a section.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.is_animation_active
entries.summary: Returns true if the an animation is currently active. An animation is active if it was played by calling play() and was not finished yet, or was stopped by calling stop().

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.is_playing
entries.summary: Returns true if an animation is currently playing (even if speed_scale and/or custom_speed are 0).

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.movie_quit_on_finish
entries.summary: If true and the engine is running in Movie Maker mode (see MovieWriter), exits the engine with SceneTree.quit() as soon as an animation is done playing in this AnimationPlayer.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.pause
entries.summary: Pauses the currently playing animation.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.play
entries.signature: void play(name: StringName = &"", custom_blend: float = -1, custom_speed: float = 1.0, from_end: bool = false)
entries.summary: Plays the animation with key name. Custom blend times and speed can be set.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.play_backwards
entries.summary: Plays the animation with key name in reverse.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.play_section
entries.signature: void play_section(name: StringName = &"", start_time: float = -1, end_time: float = -1, custom_blend: float = -1, custom_speed: float = 1.0, from_end: bool = false)
entries.summary: Plays the animation with key name and the section starting from start_time and ending on end_time. See also play().

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.play_section_backwards
entries.signature: void play_section_backwards(name: StringName = &"", start_time: float = -1, end_time: float = -1, custom_blend: float = -1)
entries.summary: Plays the animation with key name and the section starting from start_time and ending on end_time in reverse.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.play_section_with_markers
entries.signature: void play_section_with_markers(name: StringName = &"", start_marker: StringName = &"", end_marker: StringName = &"", custom_blend: float = -1, custom_speed: float = 1.0, from_end: bool = false)
entries.summary: Plays the animation with key name and the section starting from start_marker and ending on end_marker.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.play_section_with_markers_backwards
entries.signature: void play_section_with_markers_backwards(name: StringName = &"", start_marker: StringName = &"", end_marker: StringName = &"", custom_blend: float = -1)
entries.summary: Plays the animation with key name and the section starting from start_marker and ending on end_marker in reverse.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.play_with_capture
entries.signature: void play_with_capture(name: StringName = &"", duration: float = -1.0, custom_blend: float = -1, custom_speed: float = 1.0, from_end: bool = false, trans_type: TransitionType = 0, ease_type: EaseType = 0)
entries.summary: See also AnimationMixer.capture().

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.playback_auto_capture
entries.summary: If true, performs AnimationMixer.capture() before playback automatically. This means just play_with_capture() is executed with default arguments instead of play().

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.playback_auto_capture_duration
entries.summary: See also play_with_capture() and AnimationMixer.capture().

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.playback_auto_capture_ease_type
entries.summary: The ease type of the capture interpolation. See also EaseType.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.playback_auto_capture_transition_type
entries.summary: The transition type of the capture interpolation. See also TransitionType.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.playback_default_blend_time
entries.summary: The default time in which to blend animations. Ranges from 0 to 4096 with 0.01 precision.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.queue
entries.summary: Queues an animation for playback once the current animation and all previously queued animations are done.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.reset_section
entries.summary: Resets the current section. Does nothing if a section has not been set.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.seek
entries.signature: void seek(seconds: float, update: bool = false, update_only: bool = false)
entries.summary: Seeks the animation to the seconds point in time (in seconds). If update is true, the animation updates too, otherwise it updates at process time. Events between the current frame and seconds are skipped.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.set_blend_time
entries.signature: void set_blend_time(animation_from: StringName, animation_to: StringName, sec: float)
entries.summary: Specifies a blend time (in seconds) between two animations, referenced by their keys.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.set_method_call_mode
entries.summary: Deprecated: Use AnimationMixer.callback_mode_method instead.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.set_process_callback
entries.summary: Deprecated: Use AnimationMixer.callback_mode_process instead.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.set_root
entries.summary: Deprecated: Use AnimationMixer.root_node instead.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.set_section
entries.summary: Changes the start and end times of the section being played. The current playback position will be clamped within the new section. See also play_section().

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.set_section_with_markers
entries.summary: Changes the start and end markers of the section being played. The current playback position will be clamped within the new section. See also play_section_with_markers().

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.speed_scale
entries.summary: The speed scaling ratio. For example, if this value is 1, then the animation plays at normal speed. If it's 0.5, then it plays at half speed. If it's 2, then it plays at double speed.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer.stop
entries.summary: Stops the currently playing animation. The animation position is reset to 0 and the custom_speed is reset to 1.0. See also pause().

entries.name: Area2D
entries.summary: A region of 2D space that detects other CollisionObject2Ds entering or exiting it.

entries.name: Area2D.angular_damp
entries.summary: The rate at which objects stop spinning in this area. Represents the angular velocity lost per second.

entries.name: Area2D.angular_damp_space_override
entries.summary: Override mode for angular damping calculations within this area.

entries.name: Area2D.area_entered
entries.summary: Emitted when the received area enters this area. Requires monitoring to be set to true.

entries.name: Area2D.area_exited
entries.summary: Emitted when the received area exits this area. Requires monitoring to be set to true.

entries.name: Area2D.area_shape_entered
entries.signature: area_shape_entered(area_rid: RID, area: Area2D, area_shape_index: int, local_shape_index: int)
entries.summary: Emitted when a Shape2D of the received area enters a shape of this area. Requires monitoring to be set to true.

entries.name: Area2D.area_shape_exited
entries.signature: area_shape_exited(area_rid: RID, area: Area2D, area_shape_index: int, local_shape_index: int)
entries.summary: Emitted when a Shape2D of the received area exits a shape of this area. Requires monitoring to be set to true.

entries.name: Area2D.audio_bus_name
entries.summary: The name of the area's audio bus.

entries.name: Area2D.audio_bus_override
entries.summary: If true, the area's audio bus overrides the default audio bus.

entries.name: Area2D.body_entered
entries.summary: Emitted when the received body enters this area. body can be a PhysicsBody2D or a TileMap. TileMaps are detected if their TileSet has collision shapes configured. Requires monitoring to be set to true.

entries.name: Area2D.body_exited
entries.summary: Emitted when the received body exits this area. body can be a PhysicsBody2D or a TileMap. TileMaps are detected if their TileSet has collision shapes configured. Requires monitoring to be set to true.

entries.name: Area2D.body_shape_entered
entries.signature: body_shape_entered(body_rid: RID, body: Node2D, body_shape_index: int, local_shape_index: int)
entries.summary: Emitted when a Shape2D of the received body enters a shape of this area. body can be a PhysicsBody2D or a TileMap. TileMaps are detected if their TileSet has collision shapes configured.

entries.name: Area2D.body_shape_exited
entries.signature: body_shape_exited(body_rid: RID, body: Node2D, body_shape_index: int, local_shape_index: int)
entries.summary: Emitted when a Shape2D of the received body exits a shape of this area. body can be a PhysicsBody2D or a TileMap. TileMaps are detected if their TileSet has collision shapes configured.

entries.name: Area2D.get_overlapping_areas
entries.summary: Returns a list of intersecting Area2Ds. The overlapping area's CollisionObject2D.collision_layer must be part of this area's CollisionObject2D.collision_mask in order to be detected.

entries.name: Area2D.get_overlapping_bodies
entries.summary: Returns a list of intersecting PhysicsBody2Ds and TileMaps. The overlapping body's CollisionObject2D.collision_layer must be part of this area's CollisionObject2D.collision_mask in order to be detected.

entries.name: Area2D.gravity
entries.summary: The area's gravity intensity (in pixels per second squared). This value multiplies the gravity direction. This is useful to alter the force of gravity without altering its direction.

entries.name: Area2D.gravity_direction
entries.summary: The area's gravity vector (not normalized).

entries.name: Area2D.gravity_point
entries.summary: If true, gravity is calculated from a point (set via gravity_point_center). See also gravity_space_override.

entries.name: Area2D.gravity_point_center
entries.summary: If gravity is a point (see gravity_point), this will be the point of attraction.

entries.name: Area2D.gravity_point_unit_distance
entries.summary: The distance at which the gravity strength is equal to gravity. For example, on a planet 100 pixels in radius with a surface gravity of 4.0 px/s², set the gravity to 4.0 and the unit distance to 100.0.

entries.name: Area2D.gravity_space_override
entries.summary: Override mode for gravity calculations within this area.

entries.name: Area2D.has_overlapping_areas
entries.summary: Returns true if intersecting any Area2Ds, otherwise returns false. The overlapping area's CollisionObject2D.collision_layer must be part of this area's CollisionObject2D.collision_mask in order to be detected.

entries.name: Area2D.has_overlapping_bodies
entries.summary: Returns true if intersecting any PhysicsBody2Ds or TileMaps, otherwise returns false.

entries.name: Area2D.linear_damp
entries.summary: The rate at which objects stop moving in this area. Represents the linear velocity lost per second.

entries.name: Area2D.linear_damp_space_override
entries.summary: Override mode for linear damping calculations within this area.

entries.name: Area2D.monitorable
entries.summary: If true, other monitoring areas can detect this area.

entries.name: Area2D.monitoring
entries.summary: If true, the area detects bodies or areas entering and exiting it.

entries.name: Area2D.overlaps_area
entries.summary: Returns true if the given Area2D intersects or overlaps this Area2D, false otherwise.

entries.name: Area2D.overlaps_body
entries.summary: Returns true if the given physics body intersects or overlaps this Area2D, false otherwise.

entries.name: Area2D.priority
entries.summary: The area's priority. Higher priority areas are processed first. The World2D's physics is always processed last, after all areas.

entries.name: asin
entries.summary: Returns the arc sine of x in radians. Use to get the angle of sine x. x will be clamped between -1.0 and 1.0 (inclusive), in order to prevent asin() from returning @GDScript.NAN.

entries.name: asinh
entries.summary: Returns the hyperbolic arc (also called inverse) sine of x, returning a value in radians. Use it to get the angle from an angle's sine in hyperbolic space.

entries.name: assert
entries.summary: Asserts that the condition is true. If the condition is false, an error is generated and the current method returns a default value. When running from the editor, failed asserts also cause a debugger break.

entries.name: atan
entries.summary: Returns the arc tangent of x in radians. Use it to get the angle from an angle's tangent in trigonometry.

entries.name: atan2
entries.summary: Returns the arc tangent of y/x in radians. Use to get the angle of tangent y/x. To compute the value, the method takes into account the sign of both arguments in order to determine the quadrant.

entries.name: atanh
entries.summary: Returns the hyperbolic arc (also called inverse) tangent of x, returning a value in radians. Use it to get the angle from an angle's tangent in hyperbolic space if x is between -1 and 1 (non-inclusive).

entries.name: AudioServer
entries.summary: The AudioServer singleton.

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer
entries.summary: A node for audio playback.

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.autoplay
entries.summary: If true, this node calls play() when entering the tree.

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.bus
entries.summary: The target bus name. All sounds from this node will be playing on this bus.

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.finished
entries.summary: Emitted when a sound finishes playing without interruptions. This signal is not emitted when calling stop(), or when exiting the tree while sounds are playing.

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.get_playback_position
entries.summary: Returns the position in the AudioStream of the latest sound, in seconds. Returns 0.0 if no sounds are playing.

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.get_stream_playback
entries.summary: Returns the latest AudioStreamPlayback of this node, usually the most recently created by play(). If no sounds are playing, this method fails and returns an empty playback.

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.has_stream_playback
entries.summary: Returns true if any sound is active, even if stream_paused is set to true. See also playing and get_stream_playback().

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.max_polyphony
entries.summary: The maximum number of sounds this node can play at the same time. Calling play() after this value is reached will cut off the oldest sounds.

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.mix_target
entries.summary: The mix target channels. Has no effect when two speakers or less are detected (see SpeakerMode).

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.pitch_scale
entries.summary: The audio's pitch and tempo, as a multiplier of the stream's sample rate. A value of 2.0 doubles the audio's pitch, while a value of 0.5 halves the pitch.

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.play
entries.summary: Plays a sound from the beginning, or the given from_position in seconds.

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.playback_type
entries.summary: Experimental: This property may be changed or removed in future versions.

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.playing
entries.summary: If true, this node is playing sounds. Setting this property has the same effect as play() and stop().

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.seek
entries.summary: Restarts all sounds to be played from the given to_position, in seconds. Does nothing if no sounds are playing.

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.stop
entries.summary: Stops all sounds from this node.

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.stream
entries.summary: The AudioStream resource to be played. Setting this property stops all currently playing sounds. If left empty, the AudioStreamPlayer does not work.

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.stream_paused
entries.summary: If true, the sounds are paused. Setting stream_paused to false resumes all sounds.

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.volume_db
entries.summary: Volume of sound, in decibels. This is an offset of the stream's volume.

entries.name: AudioStreamPlayer.volume_linear
entries.summary: Volume of sound, as a linear value.

entries.name: bezier_derivative
entries.signature: float bezier_derivative(start: float, control_1: float, control_2: float, end: float, t: float)
entries.summary: Returns the derivative at the given t on a one-dimensional Bézier curve defined by the given control_1, control_2, and end points.

entries.name: bezier_interpolate
entries.signature: float bezier_interpolate(start: float, control_1: float, control_2: float, end: float, t: float)
entries.summary: Returns the point at the given t on a one-dimensional Bézier curve defined by the given control_1, control_2, and end points.

entries.name: Button
entries.summary: A themed button that can contain text and an icon.

entries.name: Button.alignment
entries.summary: Text alignment policy for the button's text.

entries.name: Button.autowrap_mode
entries.summary: If set to something other than TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF, the text gets wrapped inside the node's bounding rectangle.

entries.name: Button.autowrap_trim_flags
entries.summary: Autowrap space trimming flags. See TextServer.BREAK_TRIM_START_EDGE_SPACES and TextServer.BREAK_TRIM_END_EDGE_SPACES for more info.

entries.name: Button.clip_text
entries.summary: If true, text that is too large to fit the button is clipped horizontally. If false, the button will always be wide enough to hold the text.

entries.name: Button.disabled
entries.summary: StyleBox used when the Button is disabled.

entries.name: Button.disabled_mirrored
entries.summary: StyleBox used when the Button is disabled (for right-to-left layouts).

entries.name: Button.expand_icon
entries.summary: When enabled, the button's icon will expand/shrink to fit the button's size while keeping its aspect. See also icon_max_width.

entries.name: Button.flat
entries.summary: Flat buttons don't display decoration.

entries.name: Button.focus
entries.summary: StyleBox used when the Button is focused. The focus StyleBox is displayed over the base StyleBox, so a partially transparent StyleBox should be used to ensure the base StyleBox remains visible.

entries.name: Button.font
entries.summary: Font of the Button's text.

entries.name: Button.font_color
entries.summary: Default text Color of the Button.

entries.name: Button.font_disabled_color
entries.summary: Text Color used when the Button is disabled.

entries.name: Button.font_focus_color
entries.summary: Text Color used when the Button is focused. Only replaces the normal text color of the button. Disabled, hovered, and pressed states take precedence over this color.

entries.name: Button.font_hover_color
entries.summary: Text Color used when the Button is being hovered.

entries.name: Button.font_hover_pressed_color
entries.summary: Text Color used when the Button is being hovered and pressed.

entries.name: Button.font_outline_color
entries.summary: The tint of text outline of the Button.

entries.name: Button.font_pressed_color
entries.summary: Text Color used when the Button is being pressed.

entries.name: Button.font_size
entries.summary: Font size of the Button's text.

entries.name: Button.hover
entries.summary: StyleBox used when the Button is being hovered.

entries.name: Button.hover_mirrored
entries.summary: StyleBox used when the Button is being hovered (for right-to-left layouts).

entries.name: Button.hover_pressed
entries.summary: StyleBox used when the Button is being pressed and hovered at the same time.

entries.name: Button.hover_pressed_mirrored
entries.summary: StyleBox used when the Button is being pressed and hovered at the same time (for right-to-left layouts).

entries.name: Button.icon
entries.summary: Button's icon, if text is present the icon will be placed before the text.

entries.name: Button.icon_alignment
entries.summary: Specifies if the icon should be aligned horizontally to the left, right, or center of a button. Uses the same HorizontalAlignment constants as the text alignment.

entries.name: Button.icon_disabled_color
entries.summary: Icon modulate Color used when the Button is disabled.

entries.name: Button.icon_focus_color
entries.summary: Icon modulate Color used when the Button is focused. Only replaces the normal modulate color of the button. Disabled, hovered, and pressed states take precedence over this color.

entries.name: Button.icon_hover_color
entries.summary: Icon modulate Color used when the Button is being hovered.

entries.name: Button.icon_hover_pressed_color
entries.summary: Icon modulate Color used when the Button is being hovered and pressed.

entries.name: Button.icon_normal_color
entries.summary: Default icon modulate Color of the Button.

entries.name: Button.icon_pressed_color
entries.summary: Icon modulate Color used when the Button is being pressed.

entries.name: Button.language
entries.summary: Language code used for line-breaking and text shaping algorithms. If left empty, the current locale is used instead.

entries.name: Button.normal
entries.summary: Default StyleBox for the Button.

entries.name: Button.normal_mirrored
entries.summary: Default StyleBox for the Button (for right-to-left layouts).

entries.name: Button.pressed
entries.summary: StyleBox used when the Button is being pressed.

entries.name: Button.pressed_mirrored
entries.summary: StyleBox used when the Button is being pressed (for right-to-left layouts).

entries.name: Button.text
entries.summary: The button's text that will be displayed inside the button's area.

entries.name: Button.text_direction
entries.summary: Base text writing direction.

entries.name: Button.text_overrun_behavior
entries.summary: Sets the clipping behavior when the text exceeds the node's bounding rectangle.

entries.name: Button.vertical_icon_alignment
entries.summary: Specifies if the icon should be aligned vertically to the top, bottom, or center of a button. Uses the same VerticalAlignment constants as the text alignment.

entries.name: bytes_to_var
entries.summary: Decodes a byte array back to a Variant value, without decoding objects.

entries.name: bytes_to_var_with_objects
entries.summary: Decodes a byte array back to a Variant value. Decoding objects is allowed.

entries.name: Camera2D
entries.summary: Camera node for 2D scenes.

entries.name: Camera2D.align
entries.summary: Aligns the camera to the tracked node.

entries.name: Camera2D.anchor_mode
entries.summary: The Camera2D's anchor point.

entries.name: Camera2D.custom_viewport
entries.summary: The custom Viewport node attached to the Camera2D. If null or not a Viewport, uses the default viewport instead.

entries.name: Camera2D.drag_bottom_margin
entries.summary: Bottom margin needed to drag the camera. A value of 1 makes the camera move only when reaching the bottom edge of the screen.

entries.name: Camera2D.drag_horizontal_enabled
entries.summary: If true, the camera only moves when reaching the horizontal (left and right) drag margins. If false, the camera moves horizontally regardless of margins.

entries.name: Camera2D.drag_horizontal_offset
entries.summary: The relative horizontal drag offset of the camera between the right (-1) and left (1) drag margins.

entries.name: Camera2D.drag_left_margin
entries.summary: Left margin needed to drag the camera. A value of 1 makes the camera move only when reaching the left edge of the screen.

entries.name: Camera2D.drag_right_margin
entries.summary: Right margin needed to drag the camera. A value of 1 makes the camera move only when reaching the right edge of the screen.

entries.name: Camera2D.drag_top_margin
entries.summary: Top margin needed to drag the camera. A value of 1 makes the camera move only when reaching the top edge of the screen.

entries.name: Camera2D.drag_vertical_enabled
entries.summary: If true, the camera only moves when reaching the vertical (top and bottom) drag margins. If false, the camera moves vertically regardless of the drag margins.

entries.name: Camera2D.drag_vertical_offset
entries.summary: The relative vertical drag offset of the camera between the bottom (-1) and top (1) drag margins.

entries.name: Camera2D.editor_draw_drag_margin
entries.summary: If true, draws the camera's drag margin rectangle in the editor.

entries.name: Camera2D.editor_draw_limits
entries.summary: If true, draws the camera's limits rectangle in the editor.

entries.name: Camera2D.editor_draw_screen
entries.summary: If true, draws the camera's screen rectangle in the editor.

entries.name: Camera2D.enabled
entries.summary: Controls whether the camera can be active or not. If true, the Camera2D will become the main camera when it enters the scene tree and there is no active camera currently (see Viewport.get_camera_2d()).

entries.name: Camera2D.force_update_scroll
entries.summary: Forces the camera to update scroll immediately.

entries.name: Camera2D.get_drag_margin
entries.summary: Returns the specified Side's margin. See also drag_bottom_margin, drag_top_margin, drag_left_margin, and drag_right_margin.

entries.name: Camera2D.get_limit
entries.summary: Returns the camera limit for the specified Side. See also limit_bottom, limit_top, limit_left, and limit_right.

entries.name: Camera2D.get_screen_center_position
entries.summary: Returns the center of the screen from this camera's point of view, in global coordinates.

entries.name: Camera2D.get_screen_rotation
entries.summary: Returns the current screen rotation from this camera's point of view.

entries.name: Camera2D.get_target_position
entries.summary: Returns this camera's target position, in global coordinates.

entries.name: Camera2D.ignore_rotation
entries.summary: If true, the camera's rendered view is not affected by its Node2D.rotation and Node2D.global_rotation.

entries.name: Camera2D.is_current
entries.summary: Returns true if this Camera2D is the active camera (see Viewport.get_camera_2d()).

entries.name: Camera2D.limit_bottom
entries.summary: Bottom scroll limit in pixels. The camera stops moving when reaching this value, but offset can push the view past the limit.

entries.name: Camera2D.limit_enabled
entries.summary: If true, the limits will be enabled. Disabling this will allow the camera to focus anywhere, when the four limit_* properties will not work.

entries.name: Camera2D.limit_left
entries.summary: Left scroll limit in pixels. The camera stops moving when reaching this value, but offset can push the view past the limit.

entries.name: Camera2D.limit_right
entries.summary: Right scroll limit in pixels. The camera stops moving when reaching this value, but offset can push the view past the limit.

entries.name: Camera2D.limit_smoothed
entries.summary: If true, the camera smoothly stops when reaches its limits.

entries.name: Camera2D.limit_top
entries.summary: Top scroll limit in pixels. The camera stops moving when reaching this value, but offset can push the view past the limit.

entries.name: Camera2D.make_current
entries.summary: Forces this Camera2D to become the current active one. enabled must be true.

entries.name: Camera2D.offset
entries.summary: The camera's relative offset. Useful for looking around or camera shake animations. The offsetted camera can go past the limits defined in limit_top, limit_bottom, limit_left and limit_right.

entries.name: Camera2D.position_smoothing_enabled
entries.summary: If true, the camera's view smoothly moves towards its target position at position_smoothing_speed.

entries.name: Camera2D.position_smoothing_speed
entries.summary: Speed in pixels per second of the camera's smoothing effect when position_smoothing_enabled is true.

entries.name: Camera2D.process_callback
entries.summary: The camera's process callback.

entries.name: Camera2D.reset_smoothing
entries.summary: Sets the camera's position immediately to its current smoothing destination.

entries.name: Camera2D.rotation_smoothing_enabled
entries.summary: If true, the camera's view smoothly rotates, via asymptotic smoothing, to align with its target rotation at rotation_smoothing_speed.

entries.name: Camera2D.rotation_smoothing_speed
entries.summary: The angular, asymptotic speed of the camera's rotation smoothing effect when rotation_smoothing_enabled is true.

entries.name: Camera2D.set_drag_margin
entries.summary: Sets the specified Side's margin. See also drag_bottom_margin, drag_top_margin, drag_left_margin, and drag_right_margin.

entries.name: Camera2D.set_limit
entries.summary: Sets the camera limit for the specified Side. See also limit_bottom, limit_top, limit_left, and limit_right.

entries.name: Camera2D.zoom
entries.summary: The camera's zoom. Higher values are more zoomed in. For example, a zoom of Vector2(2.0, 2.0) will be twice as zoomed in on each axis (the view covers an area four times smaller).

entries.name: CameraServer
entries.summary: The CameraServer singleton.

entries.name: CanvasItem
entries.summary: Abstract base class for everything in 2D space.

entries.name: CanvasItem._draw
entries.summary: Called when CanvasItem has been requested to redraw (after queue_redraw() is called, either manually or by the engine).

entries.name: CanvasItem.clip_children
entries.summary: The mode in which this node clips its children, acting as a mask.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw
entries.summary: Emitted when the CanvasItem must redraw, after the related NOTIFICATION_DRAW notification, and before _draw() is called.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_animation_slice
entries.signature: void draw_animation_slice(animation_length: float, slice_begin: float, slice_end: float, offset: float = 0.0)
entries.summary: Subsequent drawing commands will be ignored unless they fall within the specified animation slice. This is a faster way to implement animations that loop on background rather than redrawing constantly.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_arc
entries.signature: void draw_arc(center: Vector2, radius: float, start_angle: float, end_angle: float, point_count: int, color: Color, width: float = -1.0, antialiased: bool = false)
entries.summary: Draws an unfilled arc between the given angles with a uniform color and width and optional antialiasing (supported only for positive width).

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_char
entries.signature: void draw_char(font: Font, pos: Vector2, char: String, font_size: int = 16, modulate: Color = Color(1, 1, 1, 1), oversampling: float = 0.0) const
entries.summary: Draws a string first character using a custom font. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used. pos is defined in local space.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_char_outline
entries.signature: void draw_char_outline(font: Font, pos: Vector2, char: String, font_size: int = 16, size: int = -1, modulate: Color = Color(1, 1, 1, 1), oversampling: float = 0.0) const
entries.summary: Draws a string first character outline using a custom font. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used. pos is defined in local space.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_circle
entries.signature: void draw_circle(position: Vector2, radius: float, color: Color, filled: bool = true, width: float = -1.0, antialiased: bool = false)
entries.summary: Draws a circle, with position defined in local space. See also draw_ellipse(), draw_arc(), draw_polyline(), and draw_polygon().

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_colored_polygon
entries.signature: void draw_colored_polygon(points: PackedVector2Array, color: Color, uvs: PackedVector2Array = PackedVector2Array(), texture: Texture2D = null)
entries.summary: Draws a colored polygon of any number of points, convex or concave. The points in the points array are defined in local space. Unlike draw_polygon(), a single color must be specified for the whole polygon.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_dashed_line
entries.signature: void draw_dashed_line(from: Vector2, to: Vector2, color: Color, width: float = -1.0, dash: float = 2.0, aligned: bool = true, antialiased: bool = false)
entries.summary: Draws a dashed line from a 2D point to another, with a given color and width. The from and to positions are defined in local space. See also draw_line(), draw_multiline(), and draw_polyline().

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_ellipse
entries.signature: void draw_ellipse(position: Vector2, major: float, minor: float, color: Color, filled: bool = true, width: float = -1.0, antialiased: bool = false)
entries.summary: Draws an ellipse with semi-major axis major and semi-minor axis minor. See also draw_circle(), draw_ellipse_arc(), draw_polyline(), and draw_polygon().

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_ellipse_arc
entries.signature: void draw_ellipse_arc(center: Vector2, major: float, minor: float, start_angle: float, end_angle: float, point_count: int, color: Color, width: float = -1.0, antialiased: bool = false)
entries.summary: Draws an unfilled elliptical arc between the given angles with a uniform color and width and optional antialiasing (supported only for positive width). The larger the value of point_count, the smoother the curve.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_end_animation
entries.summary: After submitting all animations slices via draw_animation_slice(), this function can be used to revert drawing to its default state (all subsequent drawing commands will be visible).

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_lcd_texture_rect_region
entries.signature: void draw_lcd_texture_rect_region(texture: Texture2D, rect: Rect2, src_rect: Rect2, modulate: Color = Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
entries.summary: Draws a textured rectangle region of the font texture with LCD subpixel anti-aliasing at a given position, optionally modulated by a color. The rect is defined in local space.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_line
entries.signature: void draw_line(from: Vector2, to: Vector2, color: Color, width: float = -1.0, antialiased: bool = false)
entries.summary: Draws a line from a 2D point to another, with a given color and width. It can be optionally antialiased. The from and to positions are defined in local space.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_mesh
entries.signature: void draw_mesh(mesh: Mesh, texture: Texture2D, transform: Transform2D = Transform2D(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0), modulate: Color = Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
entries.summary: Draws a Mesh in 2D, using the provided texture. See MeshInstance2D for related documentation. The transform is defined in local space.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_msdf_texture_rect_region
entries.signature: void draw_msdf_texture_rect_region(texture: Texture2D, rect: Rect2, src_rect: Rect2, modulate: Color = Color(1, 1, 1, 1), outline: float = 0.0, pixel_range: float = 4.0, scale: float = 1.0)
entries.summary: Draws a textured rectangle region of the multichannel signed distance field texture at a given position, optionally modulated by a color. The rect is defined in local space.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_multiline
entries.signature: void draw_multiline(points: PackedVector2Array, color: Color, width: float = -1.0, antialiased: bool = false)
entries.summary: Draws multiple disconnected lines with a uniform width and color. Each line is defined by two consecutive points from points array in local space, i.e. i-th segment consists of points[2 * i], points[2 * i + 1] endpoints.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_multiline_colors
entries.signature: void draw_multiline_colors(points: PackedVector2Array, colors: PackedColorArray, width: float = -1.0, antialiased: bool = false)
entries.summary: Draws multiple disconnected lines with a uniform width and segment-by-segment coloring.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_multiline_string
entries.signature: void draw_multiline_string(font: Font, pos: Vector2, text: String, alignment: HorizontalAlignment = 0, width: float = -1, font_size: int = 16, max_lines: int = -1, modulate: Color = Color(1, 1, 1, 1), brk_flags: BitField[LineBreakFlag] = 3, justification_flags: BitField[JustificationFlag] = 3, direction: Direction = 0, orientation: Orientation = 0, oversampling: float = 0.0) const
entries.summary: Breaks text into lines and draws it using the specified font at the pos in local space (top-left corner). The text will have its color multiplied by modulate.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_multiline_string_outline
entries.signature: void draw_multiline_string_outline(font: Font, pos: Vector2, text: String, alignment: HorizontalAlignment = 0, width: float = -1, font_size: int = 16, max_lines: int = -1, size: int = 1, modulate: Color = Color(1, 1, 1, 1), brk_flags: BitField[LineBreakFlag] = 3, justification_flags: BitField[JustificationFlag] = 3, direction: Direction = 0, orientation: Orientation = 0, oversampling: float = 0.0) const
entries.summary: Breaks text to the lines and draws text outline using the specified font at the pos in local space (top-left corner). The text will have its color multiplied by modulate.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_multimesh
entries.summary: Draws a MultiMesh in 2D with the provided texture. See MultiMeshInstance2D for related documentation.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_polygon
entries.signature: void draw_polygon(points: PackedVector2Array, colors: PackedColorArray, uvs: PackedVector2Array = PackedVector2Array(), texture: Texture2D = null)
entries.summary: Draws a solid polygon of any number of points, convex or concave. Unlike draw_colored_polygon(), each point's color can be changed individually. The points array is defined in local space.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_polyline
entries.signature: void draw_polyline(points: PackedVector2Array, color: Color, width: float = -1.0, antialiased: bool = false)
entries.summary: Draws interconnected line segments with a uniform color and width and optional antialiasing (supported only for positive width). The points array is defined in local space.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_polyline_colors
entries.signature: void draw_polyline_colors(points: PackedVector2Array, colors: PackedColorArray, width: float = -1.0, antialiased: bool = false)
entries.summary: Draws interconnected line segments with a uniform width, point-by-point coloring, and optional antialiasing (supported only for positive width).

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_primitive
entries.signature: void draw_primitive(points: PackedVector2Array, colors: PackedColorArray, uvs: PackedVector2Array, texture: Texture2D = null)
entries.summary: Draws a custom primitive. 1 point for a point, 2 points for a line, 3 points for a triangle, and 4 points for a quad.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_rect
entries.signature: void draw_rect(rect: Rect2, color: Color, filled: bool = true, width: float = -1.0, antialiased: bool = false)
entries.summary: Draws a rectangle. If filled is true, the rectangle will be filled with the color specified. If filled is false, the rectangle will be drawn as a stroke with the color and width specified.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_set_transform
entries.signature: void draw_set_transform(position: Vector2, rotation: float = 0.0, scale: Vector2 = Vector2(1, 1))
entries.summary: Sets a custom local transform for drawing via components. Anything drawn afterwards will be transformed by this.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_set_transform_matrix
entries.summary: Sets a custom local transform for drawing via matrix. Anything drawn afterwards will be transformed by this.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_string
entries.signature: void draw_string(font: Font, pos: Vector2, text: String, alignment: HorizontalAlignment = 0, width: float = -1, font_size: int = 16, modulate: Color = Color(1, 1, 1, 1), justification_flags: BitField[JustificationFlag] = 3, direction: Direction = 0, orientation: Orientation = 0, oversampling: float = 0.0) const
entries.summary: Draws text using the specified font at the pos in local space (bottom-left corner using the baseline of the font). The text will have its color multiplied by modulate.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_string_outline
entries.signature: void draw_string_outline(font: Font, pos: Vector2, text: String, alignment: HorizontalAlignment = 0, width: float = -1, font_size: int = 16, size: int = 1, modulate: Color = Color(1, 1, 1, 1), justification_flags: BitField[JustificationFlag] = 3, direction: Direction = 0, orientation: Orientation = 0, oversampling: float = 0.0) const
entries.summary: Draws text outline using the specified font at the pos in local space (bottom-left corner using the baseline of the font). The text will have its color multiplied by modulate.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_style_box
entries.summary: Draws a styled rectangle. The rect is defined in local space.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_texture
entries.signature: void draw_texture(texture: Texture2D, position: Vector2, modulate: Color = Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
entries.summary: Draws a texture at a given position. The position is defined in local space.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_texture_rect
entries.signature: void draw_texture_rect(texture: Texture2D, rect: Rect2, tile: bool, modulate: Color = Color(1, 1, 1, 1), transpose: bool = false)
entries.summary: Draws a textured rectangle at a given position, optionally modulated by a color. The rect is defined in local space. If transpose is true, the texture will have its X and Y coordinates swapped.

entries.name: CanvasItem.draw_texture_rect_region
entries.signature: void draw_texture_rect_region(texture: Texture2D, rect: Rect2, src_rect: Rect2, modulate: Color = Color(1, 1, 1, 1), transpose: bool = false, clip_uv: bool = true)
entries.summary: Draws a textured rectangle from a texture's region (specified by src_rect) at a given position in local space, optionally modulated by a color. If transpose is true, the texture will have its X and Y coordinates swapped.

entries.name: CanvasItem.force_update_transform
entries.summary: Forces the node's transform to update. Fails if the node is not inside the tree. See also get_transform().

entries.name: CanvasItem.get_canvas
entries.summary: Returns the RID of the World2D canvas where this node is registered to, used by the RenderingServer.

entries.name: CanvasItem.get_canvas_item
entries.summary: Returns the internal canvas item RID used by the RenderingServer for this node.

entries.name: CanvasItem.get_canvas_layer_node
entries.summary: Returns the CanvasLayer that contains this node, or null if the node is not in any CanvasLayer.

entries.name: CanvasItem.get_canvas_transform
entries.summary: Returns the transform of this node, converted from its registered canvas's coordinate system to its viewport's coordinate system. See also Node.get_viewport().

entries.name: CanvasItem.get_global_mouse_position
entries.summary: Returns mouse cursor's global position relative to the CanvasLayer that contains this node.

entries.name: CanvasItem.get_global_transform
entries.summary: Returns the global transform matrix of this item, i.e. the combined transform up to the topmost CanvasItem node.

entries.name: CanvasItem.get_global_transform_with_canvas
entries.summary: Returns the transform from the local coordinate system of this CanvasItem to the Viewports coordinate system.

entries.name: CanvasItem.get_instance_shader_parameter
entries.summary: Get the value of a shader parameter as set on this instance.

entries.name: CanvasItem.get_local_mouse_position
entries.summary: Returns the mouse's position in this CanvasItem using the local coordinate system of this CanvasItem.

entries.name: CanvasItem.get_screen_transform
entries.summary: Returns the transform of this CanvasItem in global screen coordinates (i.e. taking window position into account). Mostly useful for editor plugins.

entries.name: CanvasItem.get_transform
entries.summary: Returns the transform matrix of this CanvasItem.

entries.name: CanvasItem.get_viewport_rect
entries.summary: Returns this node's viewport boundaries as a Rect2. See also Node.get_viewport().

entries.name: CanvasItem.get_viewport_transform
entries.summary: Returns the transform of this node, converted from its registered canvas's coordinate system to its viewport embedder's coordinate system. See also Viewport.get_final_transform() and Node.get_viewport().

entries.name: CanvasItem.get_visibility_layer_bit
entries.summary: Returns true if the layer at the given index is set in visibility_layer.

entries.name: CanvasItem.get_world_2d
entries.summary: Returns the World2D this node is registered to.

entries.name: CanvasItem.hidden
entries.summary: Emitted when this node becomes hidden, i.e. it's no longer visible in the tree (see is_visible_in_tree()).

entries.name: CanvasItem.hide
entries.summary: Hide the CanvasItem if it's currently visible. This is equivalent to setting visible to false.

entries.name: CanvasItem.is_local_transform_notification_enabled
entries.summary: Returns true if the node receives NOTIFICATION_LOCAL_TRANSFORM_CHANGED whenever its local transform changes. This is enabled with set_notify_local_transform().

entries.name: CanvasItem.is_transform_notification_enabled
entries.summary: Returns true if the node receives NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED whenever its global transform changes. This is enabled with set_notify_transform().

entries.name: CanvasItem.is_visible_in_tree
entries.summary: Returns true if the node is present in the SceneTree, its visible property is true and all its ancestors are also visible.

entries.name: CanvasItem.item_rect_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when the CanvasItem's boundaries (position or size) change, or when an action took place that may have affected these boundaries (e.g. changing Sprite2D.texture).

entries.name: CanvasItem.light_mask
entries.summary: The rendering layers in which this CanvasItem responds to Light2D nodes.

entries.name: CanvasItem.make_canvas_position_local
entries.summary: Transforms viewport_point from the viewport's coordinates to this node's local coordinates.

entries.name: CanvasItem.make_input_local
entries.summary: Returns a copy of the given event with its coordinates converted from global space to this CanvasItem's local space. If not possible, returns the same InputEvent unchanged.

entries.name: CanvasItem.material
entries.summary: The material applied to this CanvasItem.

entries.name: CanvasItem.modulate
entries.summary: The color applied to this CanvasItem. This property does affect child CanvasItems, unlike self_modulate which only affects the node itself.

entries.name: CanvasItem.move_to_front
entries.summary: Moves this node below its siblings, usually causing the node to draw on top of its siblings. Does nothing if this node does not have a parent. See also Node.move_child().

entries.name: CanvasItem.oversampling_with_scale
entries.summary: If enabled, oversampling for this CanvasItem is automatically adjusted with scale.

entries.name: CanvasItem.queue_redraw
entries.summary: Queues the CanvasItem to redraw. During idle time, if CanvasItem is visible, NOTIFICATION_DRAW is sent and _draw() is called. This only occurs once per frame, even if this method has been called multiple times.

entries.name: CanvasItem.self_modulate
entries.summary: The color applied to this CanvasItem. This property does not affect child CanvasItems, unlike modulate which affects both the node itself and its children.

entries.name: CanvasItem.set_instance_shader_parameter
entries.summary: Set the value of a shader uniform for this instance only (per-instance uniform). See also ShaderMaterial.set_shader_parameter() to assign a uniform on all instances using the same ShaderMaterial.

entries.name: CanvasItem.set_notify_local_transform
entries.summary: If true, the node will receive NOTIFICATION_LOCAL_TRANSFORM_CHANGED whenever its local transform changes.

entries.name: CanvasItem.set_notify_transform
entries.summary: If true, the node will receive NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED whenever its global transform changes.

entries.name: CanvasItem.set_visibility_layer_bit
entries.summary: Set/clear individual bits on the rendering visibility layer. This simplifies editing this CanvasItem's visibility layer.

entries.name: CanvasItem.show
entries.summary: Show the CanvasItem if it's currently hidden. This is equivalent to setting visible to true.

entries.name: CanvasItem.show_behind_parent
entries.summary: If true, this node draws behind its parent.

entries.name: CanvasItem.texture_filter
entries.summary: The filtering mode used to render this CanvasItem's texture(s).

entries.name: CanvasItem.texture_repeat
entries.summary: The repeating mode used to render this CanvasItem's texture(s).

entries.name: CanvasItem.top_level
entries.summary: If true, this CanvasItem will not inherit its transform from parent CanvasItems. Its draw order will also be changed to make it draw on top of other CanvasItems that do not have top_level set to true.

entries.name: CanvasItem.use_parent_material
entries.summary: If true, the parent CanvasItem's material is used as this node's material.

entries.name: CanvasItem.visibility_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when the CanvasItem's visibility changes, either because its own visible property changed or because its visibility in the tree changed (see is_visible_in_tree()).

entries.name: CanvasItem.visibility_layer
entries.summary: The rendering layer in which this CanvasItem is rendered by Viewport nodes. A Viewport will render a CanvasItem if it and all its parents share a layer with the Viewport's canvas cull mask.

entries.name: CanvasItem.visible
entries.summary: If true, this CanvasItem may be drawn. Whether this CanvasItem is actually drawn depends on the visibility of all of its CanvasItem ancestors.

entries.name: CanvasItem.y_sort_enabled
entries.summary: If true, this and child CanvasItem nodes with a higher Y position are rendered in front of nodes with a lower Y position. If false, this and child CanvasItem nodes are rendered normally in scene tree order.

entries.name: CanvasItem.z_as_relative
entries.summary: If true, this node's final Z index is relative to its parent's Z index.

entries.name: CanvasItem.z_index
entries.summary: The order in which this node is drawn. A node with a higher Z index will display in front of others. Must be between RenderingServer.CANVAS_ITEM_Z_MIN and RenderingServer.CANVAS_ITEM_Z_MAX (inclusive).

entries.name: ceil
entries.summary: Rounds x upward (towards positive infinity), returning the smallest whole number that is not less than x. Supported types: int, float, Vector2, Vector2i, Vector3, Vector3i, Vector4, Vector4i.

entries.name: ceilf
entries.summary: Rounds x upward (towards positive infinity), returning the smallest whole number that is not less than x.

entries.name: ceili
entries.summary: Rounds x upward (towards positive infinity), returning the smallest whole number that is not less than x.

entries.name: char
entries.summary: Returns a single character (as a String of length 1) of the given Unicode code point code.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D
entries.summary: A 2D physics body specialized for characters moved by script.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.apply_floor_snap
entries.summary: Allows to manually apply a snap to the floor regardless of the body's velocity. This function does nothing when is_on_floor() returns true.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.floor_block_on_wall
entries.summary: If true, the body will be able to move on the floor only. This option avoids to be able to walk on walls, it will however allow to slide down along them.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.floor_max_angle
entries.summary: Maximum angle (in radians) where a slope is still considered a floor (or a ceiling), rather than a wall, when calling move_and_slide(). The default value equals 45 degrees.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.floor_snap_length
entries.summary: Sets a snapping distance. When set to a value different from 0.0, the body is kept attached to slopes when calling move_and_slide().

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.floor_stop_on_slope
entries.summary: If true, the body will not slide on slopes when calling move_and_slide() when the body is standing still.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.get_floor_angle
entries.summary: Returns the floor's collision angle at the last collision point according to up_direction, which is Vector2.UP by default.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.get_floor_normal
entries.summary: Returns the collision normal of the floor at the last collision point. Only valid after calling move_and_slide() and when is_on_floor() returns true.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.get_last_motion
entries.summary: Returns the last motion applied to the CharacterBody2D during the last call to move_and_slide().

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.get_last_slide_collision
entries.summary: Returns a KinematicCollision2D if a collision occurred. The returned value contains information about the latest collision that occurred during the last call to move_and_slide(). Returns null if no collision occurred.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.get_platform_velocity
entries.summary: Returns the linear velocity of the platform at the last collision point. Only valid after calling move_and_slide().

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.get_position_delta
entries.summary: Returns the travel (position delta) that occurred during the last call to move_and_slide().

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.get_real_velocity
entries.summary: Returns the current real velocity since the last call to move_and_slide(). For example, when you climb a slope, you will move diagonally even though the velocity is horizontal.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.get_slide_collision
entries.summary: Returns a KinematicCollision2D, which contains information about a collision that occurred during the last call to move_and_slide().

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.get_slide_collision_count
entries.summary: Returns the number of times the body collided and changed direction during the last call to move_and_slide().

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.get_wall_normal
entries.summary: Returns the collision normal of the wall at the last collision point. Only valid after calling move_and_slide() and when is_on_wall() returns true.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.is_on_ceiling
entries.summary: Returns true if the body collided with the ceiling on the last call of move_and_slide(). Otherwise, returns false. The up_direction and floor_max_angle are used to determine whether a surface is "ceiling" or not.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.is_on_ceiling_only
entries.summary: Returns true if the body collided only with the ceiling on the last call of move_and_slide(). Otherwise, returns false. The up_direction and floor_max_angle are used to determine whether a surface is "ceiling" or not.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.is_on_floor
entries.summary: Returns true if the body collided with the floor on the last call of move_and_slide(). Otherwise, returns false. The up_direction and floor_max_angle are used to determine whether a surface is "floor" or not.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.is_on_floor_only
entries.summary: Returns true if the body collided only with the floor on the last call of move_and_slide(). Otherwise, returns false. The up_direction and floor_max_angle are used to determine whether a surface is "floor" or not.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.is_on_wall
entries.summary: Returns true if the body collided with a wall on the last call of move_and_slide(). Otherwise, returns false. The up_direction and floor_max_angle are used to determine whether a surface is "wall" or not.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.is_on_wall_only
entries.summary: Returns true if the body collided only with a wall on the last call of move_and_slide(). Otherwise, returns false. The up_direction and floor_max_angle are used to determine whether a surface is "wall" or not.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.max_slides
entries.summary: Maximum number of times the body can change direction before it stops when calling move_and_slide(). Must be greater than zero.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.motion_mode
entries.summary: Sets the motion mode which defines the behavior of move_and_slide().

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.move_and_slide
entries.summary: Moves the body based on velocity. If the body collides with another, it will slide along the other body (by default only on floor) rather than stop immediately.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.platform_floor_layers
entries.summary: Collision layers that will be included for detecting floor bodies that will act as moving platforms to be followed by the CharacterBody2D. By default, all floor bodies are detected and propagate their velocity.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.platform_on_leave
entries.summary: Sets the behavior to apply when you leave a moving platform. By default, to be physically accurate, when you leave the last platform velocity is applied.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.platform_wall_layers
entries.summary: Collision layers that will be included for detecting wall bodies that will act as moving platforms to be followed by the CharacterBody2D. By default, all wall bodies are ignored.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.safe_margin
entries.summary: Extra margin used for collision recovery when calling move_and_slide().

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.slide_on_ceiling
entries.summary: If true, during a jump against the ceiling, the body will slide, if false it will be stopped and will fall vertically.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.up_direction
entries.summary: Vector pointing upwards, used to determine what is a wall and what is a floor (or a ceiling) when calling move_and_slide(). Defaults to Vector2.UP.

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.velocity
entries.summary: Current velocity vector in pixels per second, used and modified during calls to move_and_slide().

entries.name: CharacterBody2D.wall_min_slide_angle
entries.summary: Minimum angle (in radians) where the body is allowed to slide when it encounters a wall. The default value equals 15 degrees. This property only affects movement when motion_mode is MOTION_MODE_FLOATING.

entries.name: clamp
entries.signature: Variant clamp(value: Variant, min: Variant, max: Variant)
entries.summary: Clamps the value, returning a Variant not less than min and not more than max. Any values that can be compared with the less than and greater than operators will work.

entries.name: clampf
entries.signature: float clampf(value: float, min: float, max: float)
entries.summary: Clamps the value, returning a float not less than min and not more than max.

entries.name: CollisionShape2D
entries.summary: A node that provides a Shape2D to a CollisionObject2D parent.

entries.name: CollisionShape2D.debug_color
entries.summary: The collision shape color that is displayed in the editor, or in the running project if Debug > Visible Collision Shapes is checked at the top of the editor.

entries.name: CollisionShape2D.disabled
entries.summary: A disabled collision shape has no effect in the world. This property should be changed with Object.set_deferred().

entries.name: CollisionShape2D.one_way_collision
entries.summary: Sets whether this collision shape should only detect collision on one side (top or bottom).

entries.name: CollisionShape2D.one_way_collision_direction
entries.summary: The direction used for one-way collision.

entries.name: CollisionShape2D.one_way_collision_margin
entries.summary: The margin used for one-way collision (in pixels). Higher values will make the shape thicker, and work better for colliders that enter the shape at a high velocity.

entries.name: CollisionShape2D.shape
entries.summary: The actual shape owned by this collision shape.
