entries.name: Control
entries.summary: Base class for all GUI controls. Adapts its position and size based on its parent control.

entries.name: Control._accessibility_get_contextual_info
entries.summary: Return the description of the keyboard shortcuts and other contextual help for this control.

entries.name: Control._can_drop_data
entries.signature: bool _can_drop_data(at_position: Vector2, data: Variant) virtual const
entries.summary: Godot calls this method to test if data from a control's _get_drag_data() can be dropped at at_position. at_position is local to this control.

entries.name: Control._drop_data
entries.summary: Godot calls this method to pass you the data from a control's _get_drag_data() result. Godot first calls _can_drop_data() to test if data is allowed to drop at at_position where at_position is local to this control.

entries.name: Control._get_accessibility_container_name
entries.summary: Override this method to return a human-readable description of the position of the child node in the custom container, added to the accessibility_name.

entries.name: Control._get_cursor_shape
entries.summary: Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns the cursor shape for the position at_position in the control's local coordinates, which will typically be used while hovering over this control.

entries.name: Control._get_drag_data
entries.summary: Godot calls this method to get data that can be dragged and dropped onto controls that expect drop data. Returns null if there is no data to drag.

entries.name: Control._get_maximum_size
entries.summary: Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns the maximum size for this control. Alternative to custom_maximum_size for controlling maximum size via code.

entries.name: Control._get_minimum_size
entries.summary: Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns the minimum size for this control. Alternative to custom_minimum_size for controlling minimum size via code.

entries.name: Control._get_tooltip
entries.summary: Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns the tooltip text for the position at_position in the control's local coordinates, which will typically appear when the cursor is resting over this control.

entries.name: Control._get_tooltip_auto_translate_mode_at
entries.summary: Return the auto-translation mode at the given at_position. If not implemented, the tooltip_auto_translate_mode property will be used instead.

entries.name: Control._gui_input
entries.summary: Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Override this method to handle and accept inputs on UI elements. See also accept_event().

entries.name: Control._has_point
entries.summary: Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns whether the given point is inside this control.

entries.name: Control._make_custom_tooltip
entries.summary: Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns a Control node that should be used as a tooltip instead of the default one. for_text is the return value of get_tooltip().

entries.name: Control._structured_text_parser
entries.signature: Array[Vector3i] _structured_text_parser(args: Array, text: String) virtual const
entries.summary: User defined BiDi algorithm override function.

entries.name: Control.accept_event
entries.summary: Marks an input event as handled. Once you accept an input event, it stops propagating, even to nodes listening to Node._unhandled_input() or Node._unhandled_key_input().

entries.name: Control.accessibility_controls_nodes
entries.summary: The paths to the nodes which are controlled by this node.

entries.name: Control.accessibility_described_by_nodes
entries.summary: The paths to the nodes which are describing this node.

entries.name: Control.accessibility_description
entries.summary: The human-readable node description that is reported to assistive apps.

entries.name: Control.accessibility_drag
entries.summary: Starts drag-and-drop operation without using a mouse.

entries.name: Control.accessibility_drop
entries.summary: Ends drag-and-drop operation without using a mouse.

entries.name: Control.accessibility_flow_to_nodes
entries.summary: The paths to the nodes which this node flows into.

entries.name: Control.accessibility_labeled_by_nodes
entries.summary: The paths to the nodes which label this node.

entries.name: Control.accessibility_live
entries.summary: The mode with which a live region updates. A live region is a Node that is updated as a result of an external event when the user's focus may be elsewhere.

entries.name: Control.accessibility_name
entries.summary: The human-readable node name that is reported to assistive apps.

entries.name: Control.add_theme_color_override
entries.summary: Creates a local override for a theme Color with the specified name. Local overrides always take precedence when fetching theme items for the control. An override can be removed with remove_theme_color_override().

entries.name: Control.add_theme_font_override
entries.summary: Creates a local override for a theme Font with the specified name. Local overrides always take precedence when fetching theme items for the control. An override can be removed with remove_theme_font_override().

entries.name: Control.add_theme_font_size_override
entries.summary: Creates a local override for a theme font size with the specified name. Local overrides always take precedence when fetching theme items for the control. An override can be removed with remove_theme_font_size_override().

entries.name: Control.add_theme_icon_override
entries.summary: Creates a local override for a theme icon with the specified name. Local overrides always take precedence when fetching theme items for the control. An override can be removed with remove_theme_icon_override().

entries.name: Control.add_theme_stylebox_override
entries.summary: Creates a local override for a theme StyleBox with the specified name. Local overrides always take precedence when fetching theme items for the control. An override can be removed with remove_theme_stylebox_override().

entries.name: Control.anchor_bottom
entries.summary: Anchors the bottom edge of the node to the origin, the center, or the end of its parent control. It changes how the bottom offset updates when the node moves or changes size.

entries.name: Control.anchor_left
entries.summary: Anchors the left edge of the node to the origin, the center or the end of its parent control. It changes how the left offset updates when the node moves or changes size.

entries.name: Control.anchor_right
entries.summary: Anchors the right edge of the node to the origin, the center or the end of its parent control. It changes how the right offset updates when the node moves or changes size.

entries.name: Control.anchor_top
entries.summary: Anchors the top edge of the node to the origin, the center or the end of its parent control. It changes how the top offset updates when the node moves or changes size.

entries.name: Control.auto_translate
entries.summary: Deprecated: Use Node.auto_translate_mode and Node.can_auto_translate() instead.

entries.name: Control.begin_bulk_theme_override
entries.summary: Prevents *_theme_*_override methods from emitting NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED until end_bulk_theme_override() is called.

entries.name: Control.clip_contents
entries.summary: Enables whether rendering of CanvasItem based children should be clipped to this control's rectangle.

entries.name: Control.custom_maximum_size
entries.summary: The maximum size of this Control's bounding rectangle. If set to a value greater than or equal to (0, 0), the node's bounding rectangle will never exceed this size. A value below (0, 0) means there is no maximum size.

entries.name: Control.custom_minimum_size
entries.summary: The minimum size of the node's bounding rectangle. If you set it to a value greater than (0, 0), the node's bounding rectangle will always have at least this size.

entries.name: Control.end_bulk_theme_override
entries.summary: Ends a bulk theme override update. See begin_bulk_theme_override().

entries.name: Control.find_next_valid_focus

entries.name: Control.find_prev_valid_focus

entries.name: Control.focus_entered

entries.name: Control.focus_exited

entries.name: Control.focus_mode
entries.summary: Determines which controls can be focused. Only one control can be focused at a time, and the focused control will receive keyboard, gamepad, and mouse events in _gui_input().

entries.name: Control.focus_neighbor_bottom
entries.summary: Tells Godot which node it should give focus to if the user presses the down arrow on the keyboard or down on a gamepad by default. You can change the key by editing the ProjectSettings.input/ui_down input action.

entries.name: Control.focus_neighbor_left
entries.summary: Tells Godot which node it should give focus to if the user presses the left arrow on the keyboard or left on a gamepad by default. You can change the key by editing the ProjectSettings.input/ui_left input action.

entries.name: Control.focus_neighbor_right
entries.summary: Tells Godot which node it should give focus to if the user presses the right arrow on the keyboard or right on a gamepad by default. You can change the key by editing the ProjectSettings.input/ui_right input action.

entries.name: Control.focus_neighbor_top
entries.summary: Tells Godot which node it should give focus to if the user presses the top arrow on the keyboard or top on a gamepad by default. You can change the key by editing the ProjectSettings.input/ui_up input action.

entries.name: Control.focus_next
entries.summary: Tells Godot which node it should give focus to if the user presses Tab on a keyboard by default. You can change the key by editing the ProjectSettings.input/ui_focus_next input action.

entries.name: Control.focus_previous
entries.summary: Tells Godot which node it should give focus to if the user presses Shift + Tab on a keyboard by default. You can change the key by editing the ProjectSettings.input/ui_focus_prev input action.

entries.name: Control.force_drag
entries.summary: Forces drag and bypasses _get_drag_data() and set_drag_preview() by passing data and preview. Drag will start even if the mouse is neither over nor pressed on this control.

entries.name: Control.get_anchor
entries.summary: Returns the anchor for the specified Side. A getter method for anchor_bottom, anchor_left, anchor_right and anchor_top.

entries.name: Control.get_begin
entries.summary: Returns offset_left and offset_top. See also position.

entries.name: Control.get_bound_minimum_size
entries.summary: Returns the bound value of get_combined_minimum_size() by get_combined_maximum_size().

entries.name: Control.get_combined_maximum_size
entries.summary: Returns the combined maximum size from custom_maximum_size and get_maximum_size(), as well as the custom_maximum_size of this node's parent if it is a Control node with propagate_maximum_size set to true.

entries.name: Control.get_combined_minimum_size
entries.summary: Returns the combined minimum size from custom_minimum_size and get_minimum_size().

entries.name: Control.get_combined_pivot_offset
entries.summary: Returns the combined value of pivot_offset and pivot_offset_ratio, in pixels. The ratio is multiplied by the control's size.

entries.name: Control.get_cursor_shape
entries.summary: Returns the mouse cursor shape for this control when hovered over at_position in local coordinates.

entries.name: Control.get_end
entries.summary: Returns offset_right and offset_bottom.

entries.name: Control.get_focus_mode_with_override
entries.summary: Returns the focus_mode, but takes the focus_behavior_recursive into account.

entries.name: Control.get_focus_neighbor
entries.summary: Returns the focus neighbor for the specified Side. A getter method for focus_neighbor_bottom, focus_neighbor_left, focus_neighbor_right and focus_neighbor_top.

entries.name: Control.get_global_rect
entries.summary: Returns the position and size of the control relative to the containing canvas. See global_position and size.

entries.name: Control.get_maximum_size
entries.summary: Returns the maximum size for this control. See custom_maximum_size.

entries.name: Control.get_minimum_size
entries.summary: Returns the minimum size for this control. See custom_minimum_size.

entries.name: Control.get_mouse_filter_with_override
entries.summary: Returns the mouse_filter, but takes the mouse_behavior_recursive into account.

entries.name: Control.get_offset
entries.summary: Returns the offset for the specified Side. A getter method for offset_bottom, offset_left, offset_right and offset_top.

entries.name: Control.get_parent_area_size
entries.summary: Returns the width/height occupied in the parent control.

entries.name: Control.get_parent_control
entries.summary: Returns the parent control node.

entries.name: Control.get_rect
entries.summary: Returns the position and size of the control in the coordinate system of the containing node. See position, scale and size.

entries.name: Control.get_screen_position
entries.summary: Returns the position of this Control in global screen coordinates (i.e. taking window position into account). Mostly useful for editor plugins.

entries.name: Control.get_theme_color
entries.signature: Color get_theme_color(name: StringName, theme_type: StringName = &"") const
entries.summary: Returns a Color from the first matching Theme in the tree if that Theme has a color item with the specified name and theme_type.

entries.name: Control.get_theme_constant
entries.signature: int get_theme_constant(name: StringName, theme_type: StringName = &"") const
entries.summary: Returns a constant from the first matching Theme in the tree if that Theme has a constant item with the specified name and theme_type.

entries.name: Control.get_theme_default_base_scale
entries.summary: Returns the default base scale value from the first matching Theme in the tree if that Theme has a valid Theme.default_base_scale value.

entries.name: Control.get_theme_default_font
entries.summary: Returns the default font from the first matching Theme in the tree if that Theme has a valid Theme.default_font value.

entries.name: Control.get_theme_default_font_size
entries.summary: Returns the default font size value from the first matching Theme in the tree if that Theme has a valid Theme.default_font_size value.

entries.name: Control.get_theme_font
entries.signature: Font get_theme_font(name: StringName, theme_type: StringName = &"") const
entries.summary: Returns a Font from the first matching Theme in the tree if that Theme has a font item with the specified name and theme_type.

entries.name: Control.get_theme_font_size
entries.signature: int get_theme_font_size(name: StringName, theme_type: StringName = &"") const
entries.summary: Returns a font size from the first matching Theme in the tree if that Theme has a font size item with the specified name and theme_type.

entries.name: Control.get_theme_icon
entries.signature: Texture2D get_theme_icon(name: StringName, theme_type: StringName = &"") const
entries.summary: Returns an icon from the first matching Theme in the tree if that Theme has an icon item with the specified name and theme_type.

entries.name: Control.get_theme_stylebox
entries.signature: StyleBox get_theme_stylebox(name: StringName, theme_type: StringName = &"") const
entries.summary: Returns a StyleBox from the first matching Theme in the tree if that Theme has a stylebox item with the specified name and theme_type.

entries.name: Control.get_tooltip
entries.summary: Returns the tooltip text for the position at_position in the control's local coordinates, which will typically appear when the cursor is resting over this control. By default, it returns tooltip_text.

entries.name: Control.global_position
entries.summary: The node's global position, relative to the world (usually to the CanvasLayer).

entries.name: Control.grab_click_focus
entries.summary: Creates an InputEventMouseButton that attempts to click the control. If the event is received, the control gains focus.

entries.name: Control.grab_focus
entries.summary: Steal the focus from another control and become the focused control (see focus_mode).

entries.name: Control.grow_horizontal
entries.summary: Controls the direction on the horizontal axis in which the control should grow if its horizontal minimum size is changed to be greater than its current size, as the control always has to be at least the minimum size.

entries.name: Control.grow_vertical
entries.summary: Controls the direction on the vertical axis in which the control should grow if its vertical minimum size is changed to be greater than its current size, as the control always has to be at least the minimum size.

entries.name: Control.gui_input
entries.summary: Emitted when the node receives an InputEvent.

entries.name: Control.has_focus
entries.summary: Returns true if this is the current focused control. See focus_mode.

entries.name: Control.has_theme_color
entries.signature: bool has_theme_color(name: StringName, theme_type: StringName = &"") const
entries.summary: Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has a color item with the specified name and theme_type.

entries.name: Control.has_theme_color_override
entries.summary: Returns true if there is a local override for a theme Color with the specified name in this Control node.

entries.name: Control.has_theme_constant
entries.signature: bool has_theme_constant(name: StringName, theme_type: StringName = &"") const
entries.summary: Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has a constant item with the specified name and theme_type.

entries.name: Control.has_theme_font
entries.signature: bool has_theme_font(name: StringName, theme_type: StringName = &"") const
entries.summary: Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has a font item with the specified name and theme_type.

entries.name: Control.has_theme_font_override
entries.summary: Returns true if there is a local override for a theme Font with the specified name in this Control node.

entries.name: Control.has_theme_font_size
entries.signature: bool has_theme_font_size(name: StringName, theme_type: StringName = &"") const
entries.summary: Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has a font size item with the specified name and theme_type.

entries.name: Control.has_theme_font_size_override
entries.summary: Returns true if there is a local override for a theme font size with the specified name in this Control node.

entries.name: Control.has_theme_icon
entries.signature: bool has_theme_icon(name: StringName, theme_type: StringName = &"") const
entries.summary: Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has an icon item with the specified name and theme_type.

entries.name: Control.has_theme_icon_override
entries.summary: Returns true if there is a local override for a theme icon with the specified name in this Control node.

entries.name: Control.has_theme_stylebox
entries.signature: bool has_theme_stylebox(name: StringName, theme_type: StringName = &"") const
entries.summary: Returns true if there is a matching Theme in the tree that has a stylebox item with the specified name and theme_type.

entries.name: Control.has_theme_stylebox_override
entries.summary: Returns true if there is a local override for a theme StyleBox with the specified name in this Control node.

entries.name: Control.is_drag_successful
entries.summary: Returns true if a drag operation is successful. Alternative to Viewport.gui_is_drag_successful().

entries.name: Control.is_layout_rtl
entries.summary: Returns true if the layout is right-to-left. See also layout_direction.

entries.name: Control.layout_direction
entries.summary: Controls layout direction and text writing direction. Right-to-left layouts are necessary for certain languages (e.g. Arabic and Hebrew). See also is_layout_rtl().

entries.name: Control.localize_numeral_system
entries.summary: If true, automatically converts code line numbers, list indices, SpinBox and ProgressBar values from the Western Arabic (0..9) to the numeral systems used in current locale.

entries.name: Control.maximum_size_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when the node's maximum size changes.

entries.name: Control.minimum_size_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when the node's minimum size changes.

entries.name: Control.mouse_behavior_recursive
entries.summary: Determines which controls can receive mouse input together with mouse_filter. See get_mouse_filter_with_override().

entries.name: Control.mouse_default_cursor_shape
entries.summary: The default cursor shape for this control. Useful for Godot plugins and applications or games that use the system's mouse cursors.

entries.name: Control.mouse_entered
entries.summary: Emitted when the mouse cursor enters the control's (or any child control's) visible area, that is not occluded behind other Controls or Windows, provided its mouse_filter lets the event reach it and regardless if it's c…

entries.name: Control.mouse_exited
entries.summary: Emitted when the mouse cursor leaves the control's (and all child control's) visible area, that is not occluded behind other Controls or Windows, provided its mouse_filter lets the event reach it and regardless if it's…

entries.name: Control.mouse_filter
entries.summary: Determines which controls will be able to receive mouse button input events through _gui_input() and the mouse_entered, and mouse_exited signals. Also determines how these events should be propagated.

entries.name: Control.mouse_force_pass_scroll_events
entries.summary: When enabled, scroll wheel events processed by _gui_input() will be passed to the parent control even if mouse_filter is set to MOUSE_FILTER_STOP.

entries.name: Control.offset_bottom
entries.summary: Distance between the node's bottom edge and its parent control, based on anchor_bottom.

entries.name: Control.offset_left
entries.summary: Distance between the node's left edge and its parent control, based on anchor_left.

entries.name: Control.offset_right
entries.summary: Distance between the node's right edge and its parent control, based on anchor_right.

entries.name: Control.offset_top
entries.summary: Distance between the node's top edge and its parent control, based on anchor_top.

entries.name: Control.offset_transform_enabled
entries.summary: If true, applies all offset transform properties. Otherwise, no offset transform is applied and the properties have no effect.

entries.name: Control.offset_transform_pivot
entries.summary: Pivot used by offset_transform_rotation and offset_transform_scale in absolute units.

entries.name: Control.offset_transform_pivot_ratio
entries.summary: Same as offset_transform_pivot but expressed in units relative to the Control size where Vector2(0, 0) is the top-left corner of this control, and Vector2(1, 1) is its bottom-right corner.

entries.name: Control.offset_transform_position
entries.summary: Position offset in absolute units. The final offset is the combined value of this property and offset_transform_position_ratio.

entries.name: Control.offset_transform_position_ratio
entries.summary: Same as offset_transform_position but expressed in units relative to the Control size where Vector2(0, 0) is the top-left corner of this control, and Vector2(1, 1) is its bottom-right corner.

entries.name: Control.offset_transform_rotation
entries.summary: Rotation offset. The rotation pivot is defined by offset_transform_pivot and offset_transform_pivot_ratio.

entries.name: Control.offset_transform_scale
entries.summary: Scale offset. The scale pivot is defined by offset_transform_pivot and offset_transform_pivot_ratio.

entries.name: Control.offset_transform_visual_only
entries.summary: If true, the offset transforms is only applied visually and does not affect input. In other words, this Control will still receive input events at its original location before the offset transform is applied.

entries.name: Control.pivot_offset
entries.summary: By default, the node's pivot is its top-left corner. When you change its rotation or scale, it will rotate or scale around this pivot.

entries.name: Control.pivot_offset_ratio
entries.summary: Same as pivot_offset, but expressed as uniform vector, where Vector2(0, 0) is the top-left corner of this control, and Vector2(1, 1) is its bottom-right corner.

entries.name: Control.position
entries.summary: The node's position, relative to its containing node. It corresponds to the rectangle's top-left corner. The property is not affected by pivot_offset.

entries.name: Control.propagate_maximum_size
entries.summary: If true, this Control's children will use the value returned by get_combined_maximum_size() in their own size calculations.

entries.name: Control.release_focus
entries.summary: Give up the focus. No other control will be able to receive input.

entries.name: Control.remove_theme_color_override
entries.summary: Removes a local override for a theme Color with the specified name previously added by add_theme_color_override() or via the Inspector dock.

entries.name: Control.remove_theme_font_override
entries.summary: Removes a local override for a theme Font with the specified name previously added by add_theme_font_override() or via the Inspector dock.

entries.name: Control.remove_theme_font_size_override
entries.summary: Removes a local override for a theme font size with the specified name previously added by add_theme_font_size_override() or via the Inspector dock.

entries.name: Control.remove_theme_icon_override
entries.summary: Removes a local override for a theme icon with the specified name previously added by add_theme_icon_override() or via the Inspector dock.

entries.name: Control.remove_theme_stylebox_override
entries.summary: Removes a local override for a theme StyleBox with the specified name previously added by add_theme_stylebox_override() or via the Inspector dock.

entries.name: Control.reset_size
entries.summary: Resets the size to get_combined_minimum_size(). This is equivalent to calling set_size(Vector2()) (or any size below the minimum).

entries.name: Control.resized
entries.summary: Emitted when the control changes size.

entries.name: Control.rotation
entries.summary: The node's rotation around its pivot, in radians. See pivot_offset to change the pivot's position.

entries.name: Control.rotation_degrees
entries.summary: Helper property to access rotation in degrees instead of radians.

entries.name: Control.scale
entries.summary: The node's scale, relative to its size. Change this property to scale the node around its pivot_offset. The Control's tooltip will also scale according to this value.

entries.name: Control.set_anchor
entries.signature: void set_anchor(side: Side, anchor: float, keep_offset: bool = false, push_opposite_anchor: bool = true)
entries.summary: Sets the anchor for the specified Side to anchor. A setter method for anchor_bottom, anchor_left, anchor_right and anchor_top.

entries.name: Control.set_anchor_and_offset
entries.signature: void set_anchor_and_offset(side: Side, anchor: float, offset: float, push_opposite_anchor: bool = false)
entries.summary: Works the same as set_anchor(), but instead of keep_offset argument and automatic update of offset, it allows to set the offset yourself (see set_offset()).

entries.name: Control.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset
entries.signature: void set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(preset: LayoutPreset, resize_mode: LayoutPresetMode = 0, margin: int = 0)
entries.summary: Sets both anchor preset and offset preset. See set_anchors_preset() and set_offsets_preset().

entries.name: Control.set_anchors_preset
entries.signature: void set_anchors_preset(preset: LayoutPreset, keep_offsets: bool = false)
entries.summary: Sets the anchors to a preset from LayoutPreset enum. This is the code equivalent to using the Layout menu in the 2D editor.

entries.name: Control.set_begin
entries.summary: Sets offset_left and offset_top at the same time. Equivalent of changing position.

entries.name: Control.set_drag_forwarding
entries.signature: void set_drag_forwarding(drag_func: Callable, can_drop_func: Callable, drop_func: Callable)
entries.summary: Sets the given callables to be used instead of the control's own drag-and-drop virtual methods. If a callable is empty, its respective virtual method is used as normal.

entries.name: Control.set_drag_preview
entries.summary: Shows the given control at the mouse pointer. A good time to call this method is in _get_drag_data(). The control must not be in the scene tree.

entries.name: Control.set_end
entries.summary: Sets offset_right and offset_bottom at the same time.

entries.name: Control.set_focus_neighbor
entries.summary: Sets the focus neighbor for the specified Side to the Control at neighbor node path. A setter method for focus_neighbor_bottom, focus_neighbor_left, focus_neighbor_right and focus_neighbor_top.

entries.name: Control.set_global_position
entries.signature: void set_global_position(position: Vector2, keep_offsets: bool = false)
entries.summary: Sets the global_position to given position.

entries.name: Control.set_offset
entries.summary: Sets the offset for the specified Side to offset. A setter method for offset_bottom, offset_left, offset_right and offset_top.

entries.name: Control.set_offsets_preset
entries.signature: void set_offsets_preset(preset: LayoutPreset, resize_mode: LayoutPresetMode = 0, margin: int = 0)
entries.summary: Sets the offsets to a preset from LayoutPreset enum. This is the code equivalent to using the Layout menu in the 2D editor.

entries.name: Control.set_position
entries.signature: void set_position(position: Vector2, keep_offsets: bool = false)
entries.summary: Sets the position to given position.

entries.name: Control.set_size
entries.signature: void set_size(size: Vector2, keep_offsets: bool = false)
entries.summary: Sets the size (see size).

entries.name: Control.shortcut_context
entries.summary: The Node which must be a parent of the focused Control for the shortcut to be activated. If null, the shortcut can be activated when any control is focused (a global shortcut).

entries.name: Control.size
entries.summary: The size of the node's bounding rectangle, in the node's coordinate system. Container nodes update this property automatically.

entries.name: Control.size_flags_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when one of the size flags changes. See size_flags_horizontal and size_flags_vertical.

entries.name: Control.size_flags_horizontal
entries.summary: Tells the parent Container nodes how they should resize and place the node on the X axis. Use a combination of the SizeFlags constants to change the flags. See the constants to learn what each does.

entries.name: Control.size_flags_stretch_ratio
entries.summary: If the node and at least one of its neighbors uses the SIZE_EXPAND size flag, the parent Container will let it take more or less space depending on this property.

entries.name: Control.size_flags_vertical
entries.summary: Tells the parent Container nodes how they should resize and place the node on the Y axis. Use a combination of the SizeFlags constants to change the flags. See the constants to learn what each does.

entries.name: Control.theme
entries.summary: The Theme resource this node and all its Control and Window children use. If a child node has its own Theme resource set, theme items are merged with child's definitions having higher priority.

entries.name: Control.theme_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when the NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED notification is sent.

entries.name: Control.theme_type_variation
entries.summary: The name of a theme type variation used by this Control to look up its own theme items. When empty, the class name of the node is used (e.g.

entries.name: Control.tooltip_auto_translate_mode
entries.summary: Defines if tooltip text should automatically change to its translated version depending on the current locale. Uses the same auto translate mode as this control when set to Node.AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_INHERIT.

entries.name: Control.tooltip_text
entries.summary: The default tooltip text. The tooltip appears when the user's mouse cursor stays idle over this control for a few moments, provided that the mouse_filter property is not MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE.

entries.name: Control.translation_context
entries.summary: The translation context used when translating this control's displayed text, if it has any. Also used when generating translation templates.

entries.name: Control.update_maximum_size
entries.summary: Invalidates the maximum size cache in this node and in parent nodes up to top level. Intended to be used with get_maximum_size() when the return value is changed.

entries.name: Control.update_minimum_size
entries.summary: Invalidates the minimum size cache in this node and in parent nodes up to top level. Intended to be used with get_minimum_size() when the return value is changed.

entries.name: Control.warp_mouse
entries.summary: Moves the mouse cursor to position, relative to position of this Control.

entries.name: convert
entries.summary: Deprecated: Use @GlobalScope.type_convert() instead.

entries.name: cos
entries.summary: Returns the cosine of angle angle_rad in radians.

entries.name: cosh

entries.name: cubic_interpolate

entries.name: cubic_interpolate_angle

entries.name: Engine
entries.summary: The Engine singleton.

entries.name: EngineDebugger

entries.name: error_string
entries.summary: Returns a human-readable name for the given Error code.

entries.name: exp
entries.summary: The natural exponential function. It raises the mathematical constant e to the power of x and returns it.

entries.name: floor
entries.summary: Rounds x downward (towards negative infinity), returning the largest whole number that is not more than x. Supported types: int, float, Vector2, Vector2i, Vector3, Vector3i, Vector4, Vector4i.

entries.name: floorf
entries.summary: Rounds x downward (towards negative infinity), returning the largest whole number that is not more than x.

entries.name: floori
entries.summary: Rounds x downward (towards negative infinity), returning the largest whole number that is not more than x.

entries.name: fmod
entries.summary: Returns the floating-point remainder of x divided by y, keeping the sign of x.

entries.name: fposmod
entries.summary: Returns the floating-point modulus of x divided by y, wrapping equally in positive and negative.

entries.summary: The GDExtensionManager singleton.

entries.name: GDScriptLanguageProtocol
entries.summary: The GDScriptLanguageProtocol singleton.

entries.summary: The Geometry2D singleton.

entries.name: Geometry3D
entries.summary: The Geometry3D singleton.

entries.name: Input

entries.name: InputEvent
entries.summary: Abstract base class for input events.

entries.name: InputEvent.accumulate

entries.name: InputEvent.as_text
entries.summary: Returns a String representation of the event.

entries.name: InputEvent.device
entries.summary: The event's device ID.

entries.name: InputEvent.is_action
entries.signature: bool is_action(action: StringName, exact_match: bool = false) const
entries.summary: Returns true if this input event matches a pre-defined action of any type.

entries.name: InputEvent.is_action_pressed
entries.signature: bool is_action_pressed(action: StringName, allow_echo: bool = false, exact_match: bool = false) const
entries.summary: Returns true if the given action matches this event and is being pressed (and is not an echo event for InputEventKey events, unless allow_echo is true).

entries.name: InputEvent.is_action_released
entries.signature: bool is_action_released(action: StringName, exact_match: bool = false) const
entries.summary: Returns true if the given action matches this event and is released (i.e. not pressed). Not relevant for events of type InputEventMouseMotion or InputEventScreenDrag.

entries.name: InputEvent.is_action_type
entries.summary: Returns true if this input event's type is one that can be assigned to an input action: InputEventKey, InputEventMouseButton, InputEventJoypadButton, InputEventJoypadMotion, InputEventAction.

entries.name: InputEvent.is_canceled
entries.summary: Returns true if this input event has been canceled.

entries.name: InputEvent.is_echo
entries.summary: Returns true if this input event is an echo event (only for events of type InputEventKey). An echo event is a repeated key event sent when the user is holding down the key. Any other event type returns false.

entries.name: InputEvent.is_match
entries.signature: bool is_match(event: InputEvent, exact_match: bool = true) const
entries.summary: Returns true if the specified event matches this event.

entries.name: InputEvent.is_pressed
entries.summary: Returns true if this input event is pressed. Not relevant for events of type InputEventMouseMotion or InputEventScreenDrag.

entries.name: InputEvent.is_released
entries.summary: Returns true if this input event is released. Not relevant for events of type InputEventMouseMotion or InputEventScreenDrag.

entries.name: InputEvent.xformed_by
entries.signature: InputEvent xformed_by(xform: Transform2D, local_ofs: Vector2 = Vector2(0, 0)) const
entries.summary: Returns a copy of the given input event which has been offset by local_ofs and transformed by xform.

entries.name: InputEventKey
entries.summary: Represents a key on a keyboard being pressed or released.

entries.name: InputEventKey.as_text_key_label
entries.summary: Returns a String representation of the event's key_label and modifiers.

entries.name: InputEventKey.as_text_keycode
entries.summary: Returns a String representation of the event's keycode and modifiers.

entries.name: InputEventKey.as_text_location
entries.summary: Returns a String representation of the event's location. This will be a blank string if the event is not specific to a location.

entries.name: InputEventKey.as_text_physical_keycode
entries.summary: Returns a String representation of the event's physical_keycode and modifiers.

entries.name: InputEventKey.echo
entries.summary: If true, the key was already pressed before this event. An echo event is a repeated key event sent when the user is holding down the key.

entries.name: InputEventKey.get_key_label_with_modifiers
entries.summary: Returns the localized key label combined with modifier keys such as Shift or Alt. See also InputEventWithModifiers.

entries.name: InputEventKey.get_keycode_with_modifiers
entries.summary: Returns the Latin keycode combined with modifier keys such as Shift or Alt. See also InputEventWithModifiers.

entries.name: InputEventKey.get_physical_keycode_with_modifiers
entries.summary: Returns the physical keycode combined with modifier keys such as Shift or Alt. See also InputEventWithModifiers.

entries.name: InputEventKey.key_label
entries.summary: Represents the localized label printed on the key in the current keyboard layout, which corresponds to one of the Key constants or any valid Unicode character. Key labels are meant for key prompts.

entries.name: InputEventKey.keycode
entries.summary: Latin label printed on the key in the current keyboard layout, which corresponds to one of the Key constants.

entries.name: InputEventKey.location
entries.summary: Represents the location of a key which has both left and right versions, such as Shift or Alt.

entries.name: InputEventKey.physical_keycode
entries.summary: Represents the physical location of a key on the 101/102-key US QWERTY keyboard, which corresponds to one of the Key constants.

entries.name: InputEventKey.pressed
entries.summary: If true, the key's state is pressed. If false, the key's state is released.

entries.name: InputEventKey.unicode
entries.summary: The key Unicode character code (when relevant), shifted by modifier keys. Unicode character codes for composite characters and complex scripts may not be available unless IME input mode is active.

entries.name: InputEventMouseButton
entries.summary: Represents a mouse button being pressed or released.

entries.name: InputEventMouseButton.button_index
entries.summary: The mouse button identifier, one of the MouseButton button or button wheel constants.

entries.name: InputEventMouseButton.canceled
entries.summary: If true, the mouse button event has been canceled.

entries.name: InputEventMouseButton.double_click
entries.summary: If true, the mouse button's state is a double-click.

entries.name: InputEventMouseButton.factor
entries.summary: The amount (or delta) of the event. When used for high-precision scroll events, this indicates the scroll amount (vertical or horizontal).

entries.name: InputEventMouseButton.pressed
entries.summary: If true, the mouse button's state is pressed. If false, the mouse button's state is released.

entries.name: InputMap
entries.summary: The InputMap singleton.

entries.name: inst_to_dict
entries.summary: Deprecated: Consider using JSON.from_native() or Object.get_property_list() instead.

entries.name: instance_from_id
entries.summary: Returns the Object that corresponds to instance_id. All Objects have a unique instance ID. See also Object.get_instance_id().

entries.name: inverse_lerp
entries.signature: float inverse_lerp(from: float, to: float, weight: float)
entries.summary: Returns an interpolation or extrapolation factor considering the range specified in from and to, and the interpolated value specified in weight.

entries.name: IP
entries.summary: The InputMap singleton.

entries.name: is_equal_approx
entries.summary: Returns true if a and b are approximately equal to each other.

entries.name: is_finite
entries.summary: Returns whether x is a finite value, i.e. it is not @GDScript.NAN, positive infinity, or negative infinity. See also is_inf() and is_nan().

entries.name: is_inf
entries.summary: Returns true if x is either positive infinity or negative infinity. See also is_finite() and is_nan().

entries.name: is_instance_id_valid
entries.summary: Returns true if the Object that corresponds to id is a valid object (e.g. has not been deleted from memory). All Objects have a unique instance ID.

entries.name: is_instance_of
entries.summary: Returns true if value is an instance of type. The type value must be one of the following:

entries.name: is_instance_valid
entries.summary: Returns true if instance is a valid Object (e.g. has not been deleted from memory).

entries.name: is_nan
entries.summary: Returns true if x is a NaN ("Not a Number" or invalid) value. This method is needed as @GDScript.NAN is not equal to itself, which means x == NAN can't be used to check whether a value is a NaN.

entries.name: is_same
entries.summary: Returns true, for value types, if a and b share the same value. Returns true, for reference types, if the references of a and b are the same.

entries.name: is_zero_approx
entries.summary: Returns true if x is zero or almost zero. The comparison is done using a tolerance calculation with a small internal epsilon.

entries.name: JavaClassWrapper
entries.summary: The JavaClassWrapper singleton.

entries.name: JavaScriptBridge
entries.summary: The JavaScriptBridge singleton.

entries.name: Label
entries.summary: A control for displaying plain text.

entries.name: Label.autowrap_mode
entries.summary: If set to something other than TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF, the text gets wrapped inside the node's bounding rectangle. If you resize the node, it will change its height automatically to show all the text.

entries.name: Label.autowrap_trim_flags
entries.summary: Autowrap space trimming flags. See TextServer.BREAK_TRIM_START_EDGE_SPACES and TextServer.BREAK_TRIM_END_EDGE_SPACES for more info.

entries.name: Label.clip_text
entries.summary: If true, the Label only shows the text that fits inside its bounding rectangle and will clip text horizontally.

entries.name: Label.ellipsis_char
entries.summary: Ellipsis character used for text clipping.

entries.name: Label.focus
entries.summary: StyleBox used when the Label is focused (when used with assistive apps).

entries.name: Label.font
entries.summary: Font used for the Label's text.

entries.name: Label.font_color
entries.summary: Default text Color of the Label.

entries.name: Label.font_outline_color
entries.summary: The color of text outline.

entries.name: Label.font_shadow_color
entries.summary: Color of the text's shadow effect.

entries.name: Label.font_size
entries.summary: Font size of the Label's text.

entries.name: Label.get_character_bounds
entries.summary: Returns the bounding rectangle of the character at position pos in the label's local coordinate system. If the character is a non-visual character or pos is outside the valid range, an empty Rect2 is returned.

entries.name: Label.get_line_count
entries.summary: Returns the number of lines of text the Label has.

entries.name: Label.get_line_height
entries.summary: Returns the height of the line line.

entries.name: Label.get_total_character_count
entries.summary: Returns the total number of printable characters in the text (excluding spaces and newlines).

entries.name: Label.get_visible_line_count
entries.summary: Returns the number of lines shown. Useful if the Label's height cannot currently display all lines.

entries.name: Label.horizontal_alignment
entries.summary: Controls the text's horizontal alignment. Supports left, center, right, and fill (also known as justify).

entries.name: Label.justification_flags
entries.summary: Line fill alignment rules.

entries.name: Label.label_settings
entries.summary: A LabelSettings resource that can be shared between multiple Label nodes. Takes priority over theme properties.

entries.name: Label.language
entries.summary: Language code used for line-breaking and text shaping algorithms. If left empty, the current locale is used instead.

entries.name: Label.lines_skipped
entries.summary: The number of the lines ignored and not displayed from the start of the text value.

entries.name: Label.max_lines_visible
entries.summary: Limits the lines of text the node shows on screen.

entries.name: Label.normal
entries.summary: Background StyleBox for the Label.

entries.name: Label.paragraph_separator
entries.summary: String used as a paragraph separator. Each paragraph is processed independently, in its own BiDi context.

entries.name: Label.structured_text_bidi_override
entries.summary: Set BiDi algorithm override for the structured text.

entries.name: Label.structured_text_bidi_override_options
entries.summary: Set additional options for BiDi override.

entries.name: Label.tab_stops
entries.summary: Aligns text to the given tab-stops.

entries.name: Label.text
entries.summary: The text to display on screen.

entries.name: Label.text_direction
entries.summary: Base text writing direction.

entries.name: Label.text_overrun_behavior
entries.summary: The clipping behavior when the text exceeds the node's bounding rectangle.

entries.name: Label.uppercase
entries.summary: If true, all the text displays as UPPERCASE.

entries.name: Label.vertical_alignment
entries.summary: Controls the text's vertical alignment. Supports top, center, bottom, and fill.

entries.name: Label.visible_characters
entries.summary: The number of characters to display. If set to -1, all characters are displayed. This can be useful when animating the text appearing in a dialog box.

entries.name: Label.visible_characters_behavior
entries.summary: The clipping behavior when visible_characters or visible_ratio is set.

entries.name: Label.visible_ratio
entries.summary: The fraction of characters to display, relative to the total number of characters (see get_total_character_count()). If set to 1.0, all characters are displayed.

entries.name: len
entries.summary: Returns the length of the given Variant var. The length can be the character count of a String or StringName, the element count of any array type, or the size of a Dictionary.

entries.name: lerp
entries.signature: Variant lerp(from: Variant, to: Variant, weight: Variant)
entries.summary: Linearly interpolates between two values by the factor defined in weight. To perform interpolation, weight should be between 0.0 and 1.0 (inclusive).

entries.name: lerp_angle
entries.signature: float lerp_angle(from: float, to: float, weight: float)
entries.summary: Linearly interpolates between two angles (in radians) by a weight value between 0.0 and 1.0.

entries.name: lerpf
entries.signature: float lerpf(from: float, to: float, weight: float)
entries.summary: Linearly interpolates between two values by the factor defined in weight. To perform interpolation, weight should be between 0.0 and 1.0 (inclusive).

entries.name: linear_to_db
entries.summary: Converts from linear energy to decibels (audio). Since volume is not normally linear, this can be used to implement volume sliders that behave as expected.

entries.name: load
entries.summary: Returns a Resource from the filesystem located at the absolute path.

entries.name: log
entries.summary: Returns the natural logarithm of x (base e, with e being approximately 2.71828). This is the amount of time needed to reach a certain level of continuous growth.

entries.name: Marshalls
entries.summary: The Marshalls singleton.

entries.name: max
entries.summary: Returns the maximum of the given numeric values. This function can take any number of arguments.

entries.name: maxf
entries.summary: Returns the maximum of two float values.

entries.name: maxi
entries.summary: Returns the maximum of two int values.

entries.name: min
entries.summary: Returns the minimum of the given numeric values. This function can take any number of arguments.

entries.name: minf
entries.summary: Returns the minimum of two float values.

entries.name: mini
entries.summary: Returns the minimum of two int values.

entries.name: move_toward
entries.signature: float move_toward(from: float, to: float, delta: float)
entries.summary: Moves from toward to by the delta amount. Will not go past to.

entries.name: NativeMenu
entries.summary: The NativeMenu singleton.

entries.name: NavigationMeshGenerator
entries.summary: The NavigationMeshGenerator singleton.

entries.name: NavigationServer2D
entries.summary: The NavigationServer2D singleton.

entries.name: NavigationServer2DManager
entries.summary: The NavigationServer2DManager singleton.

entries.name: NavigationServer3D
entries.summary: The NavigationServer3D singleton.

entries.name: NavigationServer3DManager

entries.name: nearest_po2
entries.summary: Returns the smallest integer power of 2 that is greater than or equal to value.

entries.name: Node
entries.summary: Base class for all scene objects.

entries.name: Node._enter_tree
entries.summary: Called when the node enters the SceneTree (e.g. upon instantiating, scene changing, or after calling add_child() in a script).

entries.name: Node._exit_tree
entries.summary: Called when the node is about to leave the SceneTree (e.g. upon freeing, scene changing, or after calling remove_child() in a script).

entries.name: Node._get_accessibility_configuration_warnings
entries.summary: The elements in the array returned from this method are displayed as warnings in the Scene dock if the script that overrides it is a tool script, and accessibility warnings are enabled in the editor settings.

entries.name: Node._get_configuration_warnings
entries.summary: The elements in the array returned from this method are displayed as warnings in the Scene dock if the script that overrides it is a tool script.

entries.name: Node._get_focused_accessibility_element
entries.summary: Called during accessibility information updates to determine the currently focused sub-element, should return a sub-element RID or the value returned by get_accessibility_element().

entries.name: Node._input
entries.summary: Called when there is an input event. The input event propagates up through the node tree until a node consumes it.

entries.name: Node._physics_process
entries.summary: Called once on each physics tick, and allows Nodes to synchronize their logic with physics ticks. delta is the logical time between physics ticks in seconds and is equal to Engine.time_scale / Engine.physics_ticks_per_s…

entries.name: Node._process
entries.summary: Called on each idle frame, prior to rendering, and after physics ticks have been processed. delta is the time between frames in seconds.

entries.name: Node._ready
entries.summary: Called when the node is "ready", i.e. when both the node and its children have entered the scene tree.

entries.name: Node._shortcut_input
entries.summary: Called when an InputEventKey, InputEventShortcut, or InputEventJoypadButton hasn't been consumed by _input() or any GUI Control item. It is called before _unhandled_key_input() and _unhandled_input().

entries.name: Node._unhandled_input
entries.summary: Called when an InputEvent hasn't been consumed by _input() or any GUI Control item. It is called after _shortcut_input() and after _unhandled_key_input().

entries.name: Node._unhandled_key_input
entries.summary: Called when an InputEventKey hasn't been consumed by _input() or any GUI Control item. It is called after _shortcut_input() but before _unhandled_input().

entries.name: Node.add_child
entries.signature: void add_child(node: Node, force_readable_name: bool = false, internal: InternalMode = 0)
entries.summary: Adds a child node. Nodes can have any number of children, but every child must have a unique name.

entries.name: Node.add_sibling
entries.signature: void add_sibling(sibling: Node, force_readable_name: bool = false)
entries.summary: Adds a sibling node to this node's parent, and moves the added sibling right below this node.

entries.name: Node.add_to_group
entries.signature: void add_to_group(group: StringName, persistent: bool = false)
entries.summary: Adds the node to the group. Groups can be helpful to organize a subset of nodes, for example "enemies" or "collectables". See notes in the description, and the group methods in SceneTree.

entries.name: Node.atr
entries.signature: String atr(message: String, context: StringName = "") const
entries.summary: Translates a message, using the translation catalogs configured in the Project Settings. Further context can be specified to help with the translation.

entries.name: Node.atr_n
entries.signature: String atr_n(message: String, plural_message: StringName, n: int, context: StringName = "") const
entries.summary: Translates a message or plural_message, using the translation catalogs configured in the Project Settings. Further context can be specified to help with the translation.

entries.name: Node.auto_translate_mode
entries.summary: Defines if any text should automatically change to its translated version depending on the current locale (for nodes such as Label, RichTextLabel, Window, etc.).

entries.name: Node.call_deferred_thread_group
entries.summary: This function is similar to Object.call_deferred() except that the call will take place when the node thread group is processed.

entries.name: Node.call_thread_safe
entries.summary: This function ensures that the calling of this function will succeed, no matter whether it's being done from a thread or not.

entries.name: Node.can_auto_translate
entries.summary: Returns true if this node can automatically translate messages depending on the current locale. See auto_translate_mode, atr(), and atr_n().

entries.name: Node.can_process
entries.summary: Returns true if the node can receive processing notifications and input callbacks (NOTIFICATION_PROCESS, _input(), etc.) from the SceneTree and Viewport. The returned value depends on process_mode:

entries.name: Node.child_entered_tree
entries.summary: Emitted when the child node enters the SceneTree, usually because this node entered the tree (see tree_entered), or add_child() has been called.

entries.name: Node.child_exiting_tree
entries.summary: Emitted when the child node is about to exit the SceneTree, usually because this node is exiting the tree (see tree_exiting), or because the child node is being removed or freed.

entries.name: Node.child_order_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when the list of children is changed. This happens when child nodes are added, moved or removed.

entries.name: Node.create_tween
entries.summary: Creates a new Tween and binds it to this node.

entries.name: Node.duplicate
entries.summary: Duplicates the node, returning a new node with all of its properties, signals, groups, and children copied from the original, recursively. The behavior can be tweaked through the flags (see DuplicateFlags).

entries.name: Node.editor_description
entries.summary: An optional description to the node. It will be displayed as a tooltip when hovering over the node in the editor's Scene dock.

entries.name: Node.editor_description_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when the node's editor description field changed.

entries.name: Node.editor_state_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when an attribute of the node that is relevant to the editor is changed. Only emitted in the editor.

entries.name: Node.find_child
entries.signature: Node find_child(pattern: String, recursive: bool = true, owned: bool = true) const
entries.summary: Finds the first descendant of this node whose name matches pattern, returning null if no match is found. The matching is done against node names, not their paths, through String.match().

entries.name: Node.find_children
entries.signature: Array[Node] find_children(pattern: String, type: String = "", recursive: bool = true, owned: bool = true) const
entries.summary: Finds all descendants of this node whose names match pattern, returning an empty Array if no match is found. The matching is done against node names, not their paths, through String.match().

entries.name: Node.find_parent
entries.summary: Finds the first ancestor of this node whose name matches pattern, returning null if no match is found. The matching is done through String.match().

entries.name: Node.get_accessibility_element
entries.summary: Returns main accessibility element RID.

entries.name: Node.get_child
entries.signature: Node get_child(idx: int, include_internal: bool = false) const
entries.summary: Fetches a child node by its index. Each child node has an index relative to its siblings (see get_index()). The first child is at index 0. Negative values can also be used to start from the end of the list.

entries.name: Node.get_child_count
entries.summary: Returns the number of children of this node.

entries.name: Node.get_children
entries.summary: Returns all children of this node inside an Array.

entries.name: Node.get_groups
entries.summary: Returns an Array of group names that the node has been added to.

entries.name: Node.get_index
entries.summary: Returns this node's order among its siblings. The first node's index is 0. See also get_child().

entries.name: Node.get_last_exclusive_window
entries.summary: Returns the Window that contains this node, or the last exclusive child in a chain of windows starting with the one that contains this node.

entries.name: Node.get_multiplayer_authority
entries.summary: Returns the peer ID of the multiplayer authority for this node. See set_multiplayer_authority().

entries.name: Node.get_node
entries.summary: Fetches a node. The NodePath can either be a relative path (from this node), or an absolute path (from the SceneTree.root) to a node. If path does not point to a valid node, generates an error and returns null.

entries.name: Node.get_node_and_resource
entries.summary: Fetches a node and its most nested resource as specified by the NodePath's subname. Returns an Array of size 3 where:

entries.name: Node.get_node_or_null
entries.summary: Fetches a node by NodePath. Similar to get_node(), but does not generate an error if path does not point to a valid node.

entries.name: Node.get_node_rpc_config
entries.summary: Returns a Dictionary mapping method names to their RPC configuration defined for this node using rpc_config().

entries.name: Node.get_orphan_node_ids
entries.summary: Returns object IDs of all orphan nodes (nodes outside the SceneTree). Used for debugging.

entries.name: Node.get_parent
entries.summary: Returns this node's parent node, or null if the node doesn't have a parent.

entries.name: Node.get_path
entries.summary: Returns the node's absolute path, relative to the SceneTree.root. If the node is not inside the scene tree, this method fails and returns an empty NodePath.

entries.name: Node.get_path_to
entries.signature: NodePath get_path_to(node: Node, use_unique_path: bool = false) const
entries.summary: Returns the relative NodePath from this node to the specified node. Both nodes must be in the same SceneTree or scene hierarchy, otherwise this method fails and returns an empty NodePath.

entries.name: Node.get_physics_process_delta_time
entries.summary: Returns the time elapsed (in seconds) since the last physics callback.

entries.name: Node.get_process_delta_time
entries.summary: Returns the time elapsed (in seconds) since the last process callback. This value is identical to _process()'s delta parameter, and may vary from frame to frame. See also NOTIFICATION_PROCESS.

entries.name: Node.get_scene_instance_load_placeholder
entries.summary: Returns true if this node is an instance load placeholder. See InstancePlaceholder and set_scene_instance_load_placeholder().

entries.name: Node.get_tree
entries.summary: Returns the SceneTree that contains this node. If this node is not inside the tree, generates an error and returns null. See also is_inside_tree().

entries.name: Node.get_tree_string
entries.summary: Returns the tree as a String. Used mainly for debugging purposes. This version displays the path relative to the current node, and is good for copy/pasting into the get_node() function. It also can be used in game UI/UX.

entries.name: Node.get_tree_string_pretty
entries.summary: Similar to get_tree_string(), this returns the tree as a String. This version displays a more graphical representation similar to what is displayed in the Scene Dock. It is useful for inspecting larger trees.

entries.name: Node.get_viewport
entries.summary: Returns the node's closest Viewport ancestor, if the node is inside the tree. Otherwise, returns null.

entries.name: Node.get_window
entries.summary: Returns the Window that contains this node. If the node is in the main window, this is equivalent to getting the root node (get_tree().get_root()).

entries.name: Node.has_node
entries.summary: Returns true if the path points to a valid node. See also get_node().

entries.name: Node.has_node_and_resource
entries.summary: Returns true if path points to a valid node and its subnames point to a valid Resource, e.g. Area2D/CollisionShape2D:shape.

entries.name: Node.is_ancestor_of
entries.summary: Returns true if the given node is a direct or indirect child of this node.

entries.name: Node.is_displayed_folded
entries.summary: Returns true if the node is folded (collapsed) in the Scene dock. This method is intended to be used in editor plugins and tools. See also set_display_folded().

entries.name: Node.is_editable_instance
entries.summary: Returns true if node has editable children enabled relative to this node. This method is intended to be used in editor plugins and tools. See also set_editable_instance().

entries.name: Node.is_greater_than
entries.summary: Returns true if the given node occurs later in the scene hierarchy than this node. A node occurring later is usually processed last.

entries.name: Node.is_in_group
entries.summary: Returns true if this node has been added to the given group. See add_to_group() and remove_from_group(). See also notes in the description, and the SceneTree's group methods.

entries.name: Node.is_inside_tree
entries.summary: Returns true if this node is currently inside a SceneTree. See also get_tree().

entries.name: Node.is_multiplayer_authority
entries.summary: Returns true if the local system is the multiplayer authority of this node.

entries.name: Node.is_node_ready
entries.summary: Returns true if the node is ready, i.e. it's inside scene tree and all its children are initialized.

entries.name: Node.is_part_of_edited_scene
entries.summary: Returns true if the node is part of the scene currently opened in the editor.

entries.name: Node.is_physics_interpolated
entries.summary: Returns true if physics interpolation is enabled for this node (see physics_interpolation_mode).

entries.name: Node.is_physics_interpolated_and_enabled
entries.summary: Returns true if physics interpolation is enabled (see physics_interpolation_mode) and enabled in the SceneTree.

entries.name: Node.is_physics_processing
entries.summary: Returns true if physics processing is enabled (see set_physics_process()).

entries.name: Node.is_physics_processing_internal
entries.summary: Returns true if internal physics processing is enabled (see set_physics_process_internal()).

entries.name: Node.is_processing
entries.summary: Returns true if processing is enabled (see set_process()).

entries.name: Node.is_processing_input
entries.summary: Returns true if the node is processing input (see set_process_input()).

entries.name: Node.is_processing_internal
entries.summary: Returns true if internal processing is enabled (see set_process_internal()).

entries.name: Node.is_processing_shortcut_input
entries.summary: Returns true if the node is processing shortcuts (see set_process_shortcut_input()).

entries.name: Node.is_processing_unhandled_input
entries.summary: Returns true if the node is processing unhandled input (see set_process_unhandled_input()).

entries.name: Node.is_processing_unhandled_key_input
entries.summary: Returns true if the node is processing unhandled key input (see set_process_unhandled_key_input()).

entries.name: Node.move_child
entries.summary: Moves child_node to the given index. A node's index is the order among its siblings. If to_index is negative, the index is counted from the end of the list. See also get_child() and get_index().

entries.name: Node.multiplayer
entries.summary: The MultiplayerAPI instance associated with this node. See SceneTree.get_multiplayer().

entries.name: Node.name
entries.summary: The name of the node. This name must be unique among the siblings (other child nodes from the same parent). When set to an existing sibling's name, the node is automatically renamed.

entries.name: Node.notify_deferred_thread_group
entries.summary: Similar to call_deferred_thread_group(), but for notifications.

entries.name: Node.notify_thread_safe
entries.summary: Similar to call_thread_safe(), but for notifications.

entries.name: Node.owner
entries.summary: The owner of this node. The owner must be an ancestor of this node. When packing the owner node in a PackedScene, all the nodes it owns are also saved with it. See also unique_name_in_owner.

entries.name: Node.physics_interpolation_mode
entries.summary: The physics interpolation mode to use for this node. Only effective if ProjectSettings.physics/common/physics_interpolation or SceneTree.physics_interpolation is true.

entries.name: Node.print_orphan_nodes
entries.summary: Prints all orphan nodes (nodes outside the SceneTree). Useful for debugging.

entries.name: Node.print_tree
entries.summary: Prints the node and its children to the console, recursively. The node does not have to be inside the tree. This method outputs NodePaths relative to this node, and is good for copy/pasting into get_node().

entries.name: Node.print_tree_pretty
entries.summary: Prints the node and its children to the console, recursively. The node does not have to be inside the tree.

entries.name: Node.process_mode
entries.summary: The node's processing behavior. To check if the node can process in its current mode, use can_process().

entries.name: Node.process_physics_priority
entries.summary: Similar to process_priority but for NOTIFICATION_PHYSICS_PROCESS, _physics_process(), or NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_PHYSICS_PROCESS.

entries.name: Node.process_priority
entries.summary: The node's execution order of the process callbacks (_process(), NOTIFICATION_PROCESS, and NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_PROCESS). Nodes whose priority value is lower call their process callbacks first, regardless of tree order.

entries.name: Node.process_thread_group
entries.summary: Set the process thread group for this node (basically, whether it receives NOTIFICATION_PROCESS, NOTIFICATION_PHYSICS_PROCESS, _process() or _physics_process() (and the internal versions) on the main thread or in a sub-…

entries.name: Node.process_thread_group_order
entries.summary: Change the process thread group order. Groups with a lesser order will process before groups with a greater order.

entries.name: Node.process_thread_messages
entries.summary: Set whether the current thread group will process messages (calls to call_deferred_thread_group() on threads), and whether it wants to receive them during regular process or physics process callbacks.

entries.name: Node.propagate_call
entries.signature: void propagate_call(method: StringName, args: Array = [], parent_first: bool = false)
entries.summary: Calls the given method name, passing args as arguments, on this node and all of its children, recursively.

entries.name: Node.propagate_notification
entries.summary: Calls Object.notification() with what on this node and all of its children, recursively.

entries.name: Node.queue_accessibility_update
entries.summary: Queues an accessibility information update for this node.

entries.name: Node.queue_free
entries.summary: Queues this node to be deleted at the end of the current frame. When deleted, all of its children are deleted as well, and all references to the node and its children become invalid.

entries.name: Node.ready
entries.summary: Emitted when the node is considered ready, after _ready() is called.

entries.name: Node.remove_child
entries.summary: Removes a child node. The node, along with its children, are not deleted. To delete a node, see queue_free().

entries.name: Node.remove_from_group
entries.summary: Removes the node from the given group. Does nothing if the node is not in the group. See also notes in the description, and the SceneTree's group methods.

entries.name: Node.renamed
entries.summary: Emitted when the node's name is changed, if the node is inside the tree.

entries.name: Node.reparent
entries.signature: void reparent(new_parent: Node, keep_global_transform: bool = true)
entries.summary: Changes the parent of this Node to the new_parent. The node needs to already have a parent.

entries.name: Node.replace_by
entries.signature: void replace_by(node: Node, keep_groups: bool = false)
entries.summary: Replaces this node by the given node. All children of this node are moved to node.

entries.name: Node.replacing_by
entries.summary: Emitted when this node is being replaced by the node, see replace_by().

entries.name: Node.request_ready
entries.summary: Requests _ready() to be called again the next time the node enters the tree. Does not immediately call _ready().

entries.name: Node.reset_physics_interpolation
entries.summary: When physics interpolation is active, moving a node to a radically different transform (such as placement within a level) can result in a visible glitch as the object is rendered moving from the old to new position over…

entries.name: Node.rpc
entries.summary: Sends a remote procedure call request for the given method to peers on the network (and locally), sending additional arguments to the method called by the RPC.

entries.name: Node.rpc_config
entries.summary: Changes the RPC configuration for the given method. config should either be null to disable the feature (as by default), or a Dictionary containing the following entries:

entries.name: Node.rpc_id
entries.signature: Error rpc_id(peer_id: int, method: StringName, ...) vararg
entries.summary: Sends a rpc() to a specific peer identified by peer_id (see MultiplayerPeer.set_target_peer()).

entries.name: Node.scene_file_path
entries.summary: The original scene's file path, if the node has been instantiated from a PackedScene file. Only scene root nodes contains this.

entries.name: Node.set_deferred_thread_group
entries.summary: Similar to call_deferred_thread_group(), but for setting properties.

entries.name: Node.set_display_folded
entries.summary: If set to true, the node appears folded in the Scene dock. As a result, all of its children are hidden. This method is intended to be used in editor plugins and tools, but it also works in release builds.

entries.name: Node.set_editable_instance
entries.summary: Set to true to allow all nodes owned by node to be available, and editable, in the Scene dock, even if their owner is not the scene root.

entries.name: Node.set_multiplayer_authority
entries.signature: void set_multiplayer_authority(id: int, recursive: bool = true)
entries.summary: Sets the node's multiplayer authority to the peer with the given peer id. The multiplayer authority is the peer that has authority over the node on the network. Defaults to peer ID 1 (the server).

entries.name: Node.set_physics_process
entries.summary: If set to true, enables physics (fixed framerate) processing.

entries.name: Node.set_physics_process_internal
entries.summary: If set to true, enables internal physics for this node.

entries.name: Node.set_process
entries.summary: If set to true, enables processing. When a node is being processed, it will receive a NOTIFICATION_PROCESS on every drawn frame (and the _process() callback will be called if it exists).

entries.name: Node.set_process_input
entries.summary: If set to true, enables input processing.

entries.name: Node.set_process_internal
entries.summary: If set to true, enables internal processing for this node.

entries.name: Node.set_process_shortcut_input
entries.summary: If set to true, enables shortcut processing for this node.

entries.name: Node.set_process_unhandled_input
entries.summary: If set to true, enables unhandled input processing. It enables the node to receive all input that was not previously handled (usually by a Control).

entries.name: Node.set_process_unhandled_key_input
entries.summary: If set to true, enables unhandled key input processing.

entries.name: Node.set_scene_instance_load_placeholder
entries.summary: If set to true, the node becomes an InstancePlaceholder when packed and instantiated from a PackedScene. See also get_scene_instance_load_placeholder().

entries.name: Node.set_thread_safe
entries.summary: Similar to call_thread_safe(), but for setting properties.

entries.name: Node.set_translation_domain_inherited
entries.summary: Makes this node inherit the translation domain from its parent node. If this node has no parent, the main translation domain will be used.

entries.name: Node.tree_entered
entries.summary: Emitted when the node enters the tree.

entries.name: Node.tree_exited
entries.summary: Emitted after the node exits the tree and is no longer active.

entries.name: Node.tree_exiting
entries.summary: Emitted when the node is just about to exit the tree. The node is still valid. As such, this is the right place for de-initialization (or a "destructor", if you will).

entries.name: Node.unique_name_in_owner
entries.summary: If true, the node can be accessed from any node sharing the same owner or from the owner itself, with special %Name syntax in get_node().

entries.name: Node.update_configuration_warnings
entries.summary: Refreshes the warnings displayed for this node in the Scene dock. Use _get_configuration_warnings() to customize the warning messages to display.

entries.name: Node2D
entries.summary: A 2D game object, inherited by all 2D-related nodes. Has a position, rotation, scale, and skew.

entries.name: Node2D.apply_scale
entries.summary: Multiplies the current scale by the ratio vector.

entries.name: Node2D.get_angle_to
entries.summary: Returns the angle between the node and the point in radians. See also look_at().

entries.name: Node2D.get_relative_transform_to_parent
entries.summary: Returns the Transform2D relative to this node's parent.

entries.name: Node2D.global_position
entries.summary: Global position. See also position.

entries.name: Node2D.global_rotation
entries.summary: Global rotation in radians. See also rotation.

entries.name: Node2D.global_rotation_degrees
entries.summary: Helper property to access global_rotation in degrees instead of radians. See also rotation_degrees.

entries.name: Node2D.global_scale
entries.summary: Global scale. See also scale.

entries.name: Node2D.global_skew
entries.summary: Global skew in radians. See also skew.

entries.name: Node2D.global_transform
entries.summary: Global Transform2D. See also transform.

entries.name: Node2D.global_translate
entries.summary: Adds the offset vector to the node's global position.

entries.name: Node2D.look_at
entries.summary: Rotates the node so that its local +X axis points towards the point, which is expected to use global coordinates. This method is a combination of both rotate() and get_angle_to().

entries.name: Node2D.move_local_x
entries.signature: void move_local_x(delta: float, scaled: bool = false)
entries.summary: Applies a local translation on the node's X axis with the amount specified in delta. If scaled is false, normalizes the movement to occur independently of the node's scale.

entries.name: Node2D.move_local_y
entries.signature: void move_local_y(delta: float, scaled: bool = false)
entries.summary: Applies a local translation on the node's Y axis with the amount specified in delta. If scaled is false, normalizes the movement to occur independently of the node's scale.

entries.name: Node2D.position
entries.summary: Position, relative to the node's parent. See also global_position.

entries.name: Node2D.rotate
entries.summary: Applies a rotation to the node, in radians, starting from its current rotation. This is equivalent to rotation += radians.

entries.name: Node2D.rotation
entries.summary: Rotation in radians, relative to the node's parent. See also global_rotation.

entries.name: Node2D.rotation_degrees
entries.summary: Helper property to access rotation in degrees instead of radians. See also global_rotation_degrees.

entries.name: Node2D.scale
entries.summary: The node's scale, relative to the node's parent. Unscaled value: (1, 1). See also global_scale.

entries.name: Node2D.skew
entries.summary: If set to a non-zero value, slants the node in one direction or another. This can be used for pseudo-3D effects. See also global_skew.

entries.name: Node2D.to_global
entries.summary: Transforms the provided local position into a position in global coordinate space. The input is expected to be local relative to the Node2D it is called on. e.g.

entries.name: Node2D.to_local
entries.summary: Transforms the provided global position into a position in local coordinate space. The output will be local relative to the Node2D it is called on. e.g.

entries.name: Node2D.transform
entries.summary: The node's Transform2D, relative to the node's parent. See also global_transform.

entries.name: Node2D.translate
entries.summary: Translates the node by the given offset in local coordinates. This is equivalent to position += offset.

entries.name: Node3D
entries.summary: Base object in 3D space, inherited by all 3D nodes.

entries.name: Node3D.add_gizmo
entries.summary: Attaches the given gizmo to this node. Only works in the editor.

entries.name: Node3D.basis
entries.summary: Basis of the transform property. Represents the rotation, scale, and shear of this node in parent space (relative to the parent node).

entries.name: Node3D.clear_gizmos
entries.summary: Clears all EditorNode3DGizmo objects attached to this node. Only works in the editor.

entries.name: Node3D.clear_subgizmo_selection
