entries.summary: Deselects all subgizmos for this node. Useful to call when the selected subgizmo may no longer exist after a property change. Only works in the editor.

entries.name: Node3D.force_update_transform
entries.summary: Forces the node's global_transform to update, by sending NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED. Fails if the node is not inside the tree.

entries.name: Node3D.get_gizmos
entries.summary: Returns all the EditorNode3DGizmo objects attached to this node. Only works in the editor.

entries.name: Node3D.get_global_transform_interpolated
entries.summary: When using physics interpolation, there will be circumstances in which you want to know the interpolated (displayed) transform of a node rather than the standard transform (which may only be accurate to the most recent…

entries.name: Node3D.get_parent_node_3d
entries.summary: Returns the parent Node3D that directly affects this node's global_transform. Returns null if no parent exists, the parent is not a Node3D, or top_level is true.

entries.name: Node3D.get_world_3d
entries.summary: Returns the World3D this node is registered to.

entries.name: Node3D.global_basis
entries.summary: Basis of the global_transform property. Represents the rotation, scale, and shear of this node in global space (relative to the world).

entries.name: Node3D.global_position
entries.summary: Global position (translation) of this node in global space (relative to the world). This is equivalent to the global_transform's Transform3D.origin.

entries.name: Node3D.global_rotate
entries.summary: Rotates this node's global_basis around the global axis by the given angle, in radians. This operation is calculated in global space (relative to the world) and preserves the global_position.

entries.name: Node3D.global_rotation
entries.summary: Global rotation of this node as Euler angles, in radians and in global space (relative to the world). This value is obtained from global_basis's rotation.

entries.name: Node3D.global_rotation_degrees
entries.summary: The global_rotation of this node, in degrees instead of radians.

entries.name: Node3D.global_scale
entries.summary: Scales this node's global_basis by the given scale factor. This operation is calculated in global space (relative to the world) and preserves the global_position.

entries.name: Node3D.global_transform
entries.summary: The transformation of this node, in global space (relative to the world). Contains and represents this node's global_position, global_rotation, and global scale.

entries.name: Node3D.global_translate
entries.summary: Adds the given translation offset to the node's global_position in global space (relative to the world).

entries.name: Node3D.hide
entries.summary: Prevents this node from being rendered. Equivalent to setting visible to false. This is the opposite of show().

entries.name: Node3D.is_local_transform_notification_enabled
entries.summary: Returns true if the node receives NOTIFICATION_LOCAL_TRANSFORM_CHANGED whenever transform changes. This is enabled with set_notify_local_transform().

entries.name: Node3D.is_scale_disabled
entries.summary: Returns true if this node's global_transform is automatically orthonormalized. This results in this node not appearing distorted, as if its global scale were set to Vector3.ONE (or its negative counterpart).

entries.name: Node3D.is_transform_notification_enabled
entries.summary: Returns true if the node receives NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED whenever global_transform changes. This is enabled with set_notify_transform().

entries.name: Node3D.is_visible_in_tree
entries.summary: Returns true if this node is inside the scene tree and the visible property is true for this node and all of its Node3D ancestors in sequence. An ancestor of any other type (such as Node or Node2D) breaks the sequence.

entries.name: Node3D.look_at
entries.signature: void look_at(target: Vector3, up: Vector3 = Vector3(0, 1, 0), use_model_front: bool = false)
entries.summary: Rotates the node so that the local forward axis (-Z, Vector3.FORWARD) points toward the target position. This operation is calculated in global space (relative to the world).

entries.name: Node3D.look_at_from_position
entries.signature: void look_at_from_position(position: Vector3, target: Vector3, up: Vector3 = Vector3(0, 1, 0), use_model_front: bool = false)
entries.summary: Moves the node to the specified position, then rotates the node to point toward the target position, similar to look_at(). This operation is calculated in global space (relative to the world).

entries.name: Node3D.orthonormalize
entries.summary: Orthonormalizes this node's basis. This method sets this node's scale to Vector3.ONE (or its negative counterpart), but preserves the position and rotation. See also Transform3D.orthonormalized().

entries.name: Node3D.position
entries.summary: Position (translation) of this node in parent space (relative to the parent node). This is equivalent to the transform's Transform3D.origin.

entries.name: Node3D.quaternion
entries.summary: Rotation of this node represented as a Quaternion in parent space (relative to the parent node). This value is obtained from basis's rotation.

entries.name: Node3D.rotate
entries.summary: Rotates this node's basis around the axis by the given angle, in radians. This operation is calculated in parent space (relative to the parent) and preserves the position.

entries.name: Node3D.rotate_object_local
entries.summary: Rotates this node's basis around the axis by the given angle, in radians. This operation is calculated in local space (relative to this node) and preserves the position.

entries.name: Node3D.rotate_x
entries.summary: Rotates this node's basis around the X axis by the given angle, in radians. This operation is calculated in parent space (relative to the parent) and preserves the position.

entries.name: Node3D.rotate_y
entries.summary: Rotates this node's basis around the Y axis by the given angle, in radians. This operation is calculated in parent space (relative to the parent) and preserves the position.

entries.name: Node3D.rotate_z
entries.summary: Rotates this node's basis around the Z axis by the given angle, in radians. This operation is calculated in parent space (relative to the parent) and preserves the position.

entries.name: Node3D.rotation
entries.summary: Rotation of this node as Euler angles, in radians and in parent space (relative to the parent node). This value is obtained from basis's rotation.

entries.name: Node3D.rotation_degrees
entries.summary: The rotation of this node, in degrees instead of radians.

entries.name: Node3D.rotation_edit_mode
entries.summary: How this node's rotation and scale are displayed in the Inspector dock.

entries.name: Node3D.rotation_order
entries.summary: The axis rotation order of the rotation property. In Godot, Euler angles always use intrinsic order, meaning that the final orientation is calculated by rotating around the local axes in this order.

entries.name: Node3D.scale
entries.summary: Scale of this node in local space (relative to this node). This value is obtained from basis's scale.

entries.name: Node3D.scale_object_local
entries.summary: Scales this node's basis by the given scale factor. This operation is calculated in local space (relative to this node) and preserves the position.

entries.name: Node3D.set_disable_scale
entries.summary: If true, this node's global_transform is automatically orthonormalized. This results in this node not appearing distorted, as if its global scale were set to Vector3.ONE (or its negative counterpart).

entries.name: Node3D.set_identity
entries.summary: Sets this node's transform to Transform3D.IDENTITY, which resets all transformations in parent space (position, rotation, and scale).

entries.name: Node3D.set_ignore_transform_notification
entries.summary: If true, the node will not receive NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED or NOTIFICATION_LOCAL_TRANSFORM_CHANGED.

entries.name: Node3D.set_notify_local_transform
entries.summary: If true, the node will receive NOTIFICATION_LOCAL_TRANSFORM_CHANGED whenever transform changes.

entries.name: Node3D.set_notify_transform
entries.summary: If true, the node will receive NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED whenever global_transform changes.

entries.name: Node3D.set_subgizmo_selection
entries.signature: void set_subgizmo_selection(gizmo: Node3DGizmo, id: int, transform: Transform3D)
entries.summary: Selects the gizmo's subgizmo with the given id and sets its transform. Only works in the editor.

entries.name: Node3D.show
entries.summary: Allows this node to be rendered. Equivalent to setting visible to true. This is the opposite of hide().

entries.name: Node3D.to_global
entries.summary: Returns the local_point converted from this node's local space to global space. This is the opposite of to_local().

entries.name: Node3D.to_local
entries.summary: Returns the global_point converted from global space to this node's local space. This is the opposite of to_global().

entries.name: Node3D.top_level
entries.summary: If true, the node does not inherit its transformations from its parent. As such, node transformations will only be in global space, which also means that global_transform and transform will be identical.

entries.name: Node3D.transform
entries.summary: The local transformation of this node, in parent space (relative to the parent node). Contains and represents this node's position, rotation, and scale.

entries.name: Node3D.translate
entries.summary: Adds the given translation offset to the node's position, in local space (relative to this node).

entries.name: Node3D.translate_object_local
entries.summary: Adds the given translation offset to the node's position, in local space (relative to this node).

entries.name: Node3D.update_gizmos
entries.summary: Updates all the EditorNode3DGizmo objects attached to this node. Only works in the editor.

entries.name: Node3D.visibility_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when this node's visibility changes (see visible and is_visible_in_tree()).

entries.name: Node3D.visibility_parent
entries.summary: Path to the visibility range parent for this node and its descendants. The visibility parent must be a GeometryInstance3D.

entries.name: Node3D.visible
entries.summary: If true, this node can be visible. The node is only rendered when all of its ancestors are visible, as well. That means is_visible_in_tree() must return true.

entries.name: Object
entries.summary: Base class for all other classes in the engine.

entries.name: Object._get
entries.summary: Override this method to customize the behavior of get(). Should return the given property's value, or null if the property should be handled normally.

entries.name: Object._get_property_list
entries.summary: Override this method to provide a custom list of additional properties to handle by the engine.

entries.name: Object._init
entries.summary: Called when the object's script is instantiated, oftentimes after the object is initialized in memory (through Object.new() in GDScript, or new GodotObject in C#). It can be also defined to take in parameters.

entries.name: Object._iter_get
entries.summary: Returns the current iterable value. iter stores the iteration state, but unlike _iter_init() and _iter_next() the state is supposed to be read-only, so there is no Array wrapper.

entries.name: Object._iter_init
entries.summary: Initializes the iterator. iter stores the iteration state. Since GDScript does not support passing arguments by reference, a single-element array is used as a wrapper.

entries.name: Object._iter_next
entries.summary: Moves the iterator to the next iteration. iter stores the iteration state. Since GDScript does not support passing arguments by reference, a single-element array is used as a wrapper.

entries.name: Object._notification
entries.summary: Called when the object receives a notification, which can be identified in what by comparing it with a constant. See also notification().

entries.name: Object._property_can_revert
entries.summary: Override this method to customize the given property's revert behavior. Should return true if the property has a custom default value and is revertible in the Inspector dock.

entries.name: Object._property_get_revert
entries.summary: Override this method to customize the given property's revert behavior. Should return the default value for the property.

entries.name: Object._set
entries.summary: Override this method to customize the behavior of set(). Should set the property to value and return true, or false if the property should be handled normally.

entries.name: Object._to_string
entries.summary: Override this method to customize the return value of to_string(), and therefore the object's representation as a String.

entries.name: Object._validate_property
entries.summary: Override this method to customize existing properties. Every property info goes through this method, except properties added with _get_property_list(). The dictionary contents is the same as in _get_property_list().

entries.name: Object.add_user_signal
entries.summary: Adds a user-defined signal named signal. Optional arguments for the signal can be added as an Array of dictionaries, each defining a name String and a type int (see Variant.Type).

entries.name: Object.call
entries.summary: Calls the method on the object and returns the result. This method supports a variable number of arguments, so parameters can be passed as a comma separated list.

entries.name: Object.call_deferred
entries.summary: Calls the method on the object during idle time. Always returns null, not the method's result.

entries.name: Object.callv
entries.summary: Calls the method on the object and returns the result. Unlike call(), this method expects all parameters to be contained inside arg_array.

entries.name: Object.can_translate_messages
entries.summary: Returns true if the object is allowed to translate messages with tr() and tr_n(). See also set_message_translation().

entries.name: Object.cancel_free
entries.summary: If this method is called during NOTIFICATION_PREDELETE, this object will reject being freed and will remain allocated.

entries.name: Object.connect
entries.signature: Error connect(signal: StringName, callable: Callable, flags: int = 0)
entries.summary: Connects a signal by name to a callable. Optional flags can be also added to configure the connection's behavior (see ConnectFlags constants).

entries.name: Object.disconnect
entries.summary: Disconnects a signal by name from a given callable. If the connection does not exist, generates an error. Use is_connected() to make sure that the connection exists.

entries.name: Object.emit_signal
entries.summary: Emits the given signal by name. The signal must exist, so it should be a built-in signal of this class or one of its inherited classes, or a user-defined signal (see add_user_signal()).

entries.name: Object.free
entries.summary: Deletes the object from memory. Pre-existing references to the object become invalid, and any attempt to access them will result in a runtime error.

entries.name: Object.get
entries.summary: Returns the Variant value of the given property. If the property does not exist, this method returns null.

entries.name: Object.get_class
entries.summary: Returns the object's built-in class name, as a String. See also is_class().

entries.name: Object.get_incoming_connections
entries.summary: Returns an Array of signal connections received by this object. Each connection is represented as a Dictionary that contains three entries:

entries.name: Object.get_indexed
entries.summary: Gets the object's property indexed by the given property_path. The path should be a NodePath relative to the current object and can use the colon character (:) to access nested properties.

entries.name: Object.get_instance_id
entries.summary: Returns the object's unique instance ID. This ID can be saved in EncodedObjectAsID, and can be used to retrieve this object instance with @GlobalScope.instance_from_id().

entries.name: Object.get_meta
entries.signature: Variant get_meta(name: StringName, default: Variant = null) const
entries.summary: Returns the object's metadata value for the given entry name. If the entry does not exist, returns default. If default is null, an error is also generated.

entries.name: Object.get_meta_list
entries.summary: Returns the object's metadata entry names as an Array of StringNames.

entries.name: Object.get_method_argument_count
entries.summary: Returns the number of arguments of the given method by name.

entries.name: Object.get_method_list
entries.summary: Returns this object's methods and their signatures as an Array of dictionaries. Each Dictionary contains the following entries:

entries.name: Object.get_property_list
entries.summary: Returns the object's property list as an Array of dictionaries. Each Dictionary contains the following entries:

entries.name: Object.get_script
entries.summary: Returns the object's Script instance, or null if no script is attached.

entries.name: Object.get_signal_connection_list
entries.summary: Returns an Array of connections for the given signal name. Each connection is represented as a Dictionary that contains three entries:

entries.name: Object.get_signal_list
entries.summary: Returns the list of existing signals as an Array of dictionaries.

entries.name: Object.get_translation_domain
entries.summary: Returns the name of the translation domain used by tr() and tr_n(). See also TranslationServer.

entries.name: Object.has_connections
entries.summary: Returns true if any connection exists on the given signal name.

entries.name: Object.has_meta
entries.summary: Returns true if a metadata entry is found with the given name. See also get_meta(), set_meta() and remove_meta().

entries.name: Object.has_method
entries.summary: Returns true if the given method name exists in the object.

entries.name: Object.has_signal
entries.summary: Returns true if the given signal name exists in the object.

entries.name: Object.has_user_signal
entries.summary: Returns true if the given user-defined signal name exists. Only signals added with add_user_signal() are included. See also remove_user_signal().

entries.name: Object.is_blocking_signals
entries.summary: Returns true if the object is blocking its signals from being emitted. See set_block_signals().

entries.name: Object.is_class
entries.summary: Returns true if the object inherits from the given class. See also get_class().

entries.name: Object.is_connected
entries.signature: bool is_connected(signal: StringName, callable: Callable) const
entries.summary: Returns true if a connection exists between the given signal name and callable.

entries.name: Object.is_queued_for_deletion
entries.summary: Returns true if the methods Node.queue_free() or SceneTree.queue_delete() was called for the object.

entries.name: Object.notification
entries.signature: void notification(what: int, reversed: bool = false)
entries.summary: Sends the given what notification to all classes inherited by the object, triggering calls to _notification(), starting from the highest ancestor (the Object class) and going down to the object's script.

entries.name: Object.notify_property_list_changed
entries.summary: Emits the property_list_changed signal. This is mainly used to refresh the editor, so that the Inspector and editor plugins are properly updated.

entries.name: Object.property_can_revert
entries.summary: Returns true if the given property has a custom default value. Use property_get_revert() to get the property's default value.

entries.name: Object.property_get_revert
entries.summary: Returns the custom default value of the given property. Use property_can_revert() to check if the property has a custom default value.

entries.name: Object.property_list_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when notify_property_list_changed() is called.

entries.name: Object.remove_meta
entries.summary: Removes the given entry name from the object's metadata. See also has_meta(), get_meta() and set_meta().

entries.name: Object.remove_user_signal
entries.summary: Removes the given user signal signal from the object. See also add_user_signal() and has_user_signal().

entries.name: Object.script_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when the object's script is changed.

entries.name: Object.set
entries.summary: Assigns value to the given property. If the property does not exist or the given value's type doesn't match, nothing happens.

entries.name: Object.set_block_signals
entries.summary: If set to true, the object becomes unable to emit signals. As such, emit_signal() and signal connections will not work, until it is set to false.

entries.name: Object.set_deferred
entries.summary: Assigns value to the given property, at the end of the current frame. This is equivalent to calling set() through call_deferred().

entries.name: Object.set_indexed
entries.summary: Assigns a new value to the property identified by the property_path. The path should be a NodePath relative to this object, and can use the colon character (:) to access nested properties.

entries.name: Object.set_message_translation
entries.summary: If set to true, allows the object to translate messages with tr() and tr_n(). Enabled by default. See also can_translate_messages().

entries.name: Object.set_meta
entries.summary: Adds or changes the entry name inside the object's metadata. The metadata value can be any Variant, although some types cannot be serialized correctly.

entries.name: Object.set_script
entries.summary: Attaches script to the object, and instantiates it. As a result, the script's _init() is called. A Script is used to extend the object's functionality.

entries.name: Object.set_translation_domain
entries.summary: Sets the name of the translation domain used by tr() and tr_n(). See also TranslationServer.

entries.name: Object.to_string
entries.summary: Returns a String representing the object. Defaults to "<ClassName#RID>". Override _to_string() to customize the string representation of the object.

entries.name: Object.tr
entries.signature: String tr(message: StringName, context: StringName = &"") const
entries.summary: Translates a message, using the translation catalogs configured in the Project Settings. Further context can be specified to help with the translation.

entries.name: Object.tr_n
entries.signature: String tr_n(message: StringName, plural_message: StringName, n: int, context: StringName = &"") const
entries.summary: Translates a message or plural_message, using the translation catalogs configured in the Project Settings. Further context can be specified to help with the translation.

entries.name: ord
entries.summary: Returns an integer representing the Unicode code point of the given character char, which should be a string of length 1.

entries.name: OS
entries.summary: The Performance singleton.

entries.name: PackedScene
entries.summary: An abstraction of a serialized scene.

entries.name: PackedScene.can_instantiate
entries.summary: Returns true if the scene file has nodes.

entries.name: PackedScene.get_state
entries.summary: Returns the SceneState representing the scene file contents.

entries.name: PackedScene.instantiate
entries.summary: Instantiates the scene's node hierarchy. Triggers child scene instantiation(s). Triggers a Node.NOTIFICATION_SCENE_INSTANTIATED notification on the root node.

entries.name: PackedScene.pack
entries.summary: Packs the path node, and all owned sub-nodes, into this PackedScene. Any existing data will be cleared. See Node.owner.

entries.name: Performance
entries.summary: The Performance singleton.

entries.name: PhysicsServer2D
entries.summary: The PhysicsServer2D singleton.

entries.name: PhysicsServer2DManager
entries.summary: The PhysicsServer2DManager singleton.

entries.name: PhysicsServer3D
entries.summary: The PhysicsServer3D singleton.

entries.name: PhysicsServer3DManager
entries.summary: The PhysicsServer3DManager singleton.

entries.name: pingpong
entries.summary: Wraps value between 0 and the length. If the limit is reached, the next value the function returns is decreased to the 0 side or increased to the length side (like a triangle wave).

entries.name: posmod
entries.summary: Returns the integer modulus of x divided by y that wraps equally in positive and negative.

entries.name: pow
entries.summary: Returns the result of base raised to the power of exp.

entries.name: preload
entries.summary: Returns a Resource from the filesystem located at path. During run-time, the resource is loaded when the script is being parsed. This function effectively acts as a reference to that resource.

entries.name: print
entries.summary: Converts one or more arguments of any type to string in the best way possible and prints them to the console.

entries.name: print_debug
entries.summary: Like @GlobalScope.print(), but includes the current stack frame when running with the debugger turned on.

entries.name: print_rich
entries.summary: Converts one or more arguments of any type to string in the best way possible and prints them to the console.

entries.name: print_stack
entries.summary: Prints a stack trace at the current code location.

entries.name: print_verbose
entries.summary: If verbose mode is enabled (OS.is_stdout_verbose() returning true), converts one or more arguments of any type to string in the best way possible and prints them to the console.

entries.name: printerr
entries.summary: Prints one or more arguments to strings in the best way possible to standard error line.

entries.name: printraw
entries.summary: Prints one or more arguments to strings in the best way possible to the OS terminal. Unlike print(), no newline is automatically added at the end.

entries.name: prints
entries.summary: Prints one or more arguments to the console with a space between each argument.

entries.name: printt
entries.summary: Prints one or more arguments to the console with a tab between each argument.

entries.name: ProjectSettings
entries.summary: The ProjectSettings singleton.

entries.name: push_error
entries.summary: Pushes an error message to Godot's built-in debugger and to the OS terminal.

entries.name: push_warning
entries.summary: Pushes a warning message to Godot's built-in debugger and to the OS terminal.

entries.name: rad_to_deg
entries.summary: Converts an angle expressed in radians to degrees.

entries.name: rand_from_seed
entries.summary: Given a seed, returns a PackedInt64Array of size 2, where its first element is the randomized int value, and the second element is the same as seed. Passing the same seed consistently returns the same array.

entries.name: randf
entries.summary: Returns a random floating-point value between 0.0 and 1.0 (inclusive).

entries.name: randf_range
entries.summary: Returns a random floating-point value between from and to (inclusive).

entries.name: randfn
entries.summary: Returns a normally-distributed, pseudo-random floating-point value from the specified mean and a standard deviation. This is also known as a Gaussian distribution.

entries.name: randi
entries.summary: Returns a random unsigned 32-bit integer. Use remainder to obtain a random value in the interval [0, N - 1] (where N is smaller than 2^32).

entries.name: randi_range
entries.summary: Returns a random signed 32-bit integer between from and to (inclusive). If to is lesser than from, they are swapped.

entries.name: randomize
entries.summary: Randomizes the seed (or the internal state) of the random number generator. The current implementation uses a number based on the device's time.

entries.name: range
entries.summary: Returns an array with the given range. range() can be called in three ways:

entries.name: RayCast2D
entries.summary: A ray in 2D space, used to find the first collision object it intersects.

entries.name: RayCast2D.add_exception
entries.summary: Adds a collision exception so the ray does not report collisions with the specified node.

entries.name: RayCast2D.add_exception_rid
entries.summary: Adds a collision exception so the ray does not report collisions with the specified RID.

entries.name: RayCast2D.clear_exceptions
entries.summary: Removes all collision exceptions for this ray.

entries.name: RayCast2D.collide_with_areas
entries.summary: If true, collisions with Area2Ds will be reported.

entries.name: RayCast2D.collide_with_bodies
entries.summary: If true, collisions with PhysicsBody2Ds will be reported.

entries.name: RayCast2D.collision_mask
entries.summary: The ray's collision mask. Only objects in at least one collision layer enabled in the mask will be detected. See Collision layers and masks in the documentation for more information.

entries.name: RayCast2D.enabled
entries.summary: If true, collisions will be reported.

entries.name: RayCast2D.exclude_parent
entries.summary: If true, this raycast will not report collisions with its parent node. This property only has an effect if the parent node is a CollisionObject2D. See also Node.get_parent() and add_exception().

entries.name: RayCast2D.force_raycast_update
entries.summary: Updates the collision information for the ray immediately, without waiting for the next _physics_process call. Use this method, for example, when the ray or its parent has changed state.

entries.name: RayCast2D.get_collider
entries.summary: Returns the first object that the ray intersects, or null if no object is intersecting the ray (i.e. is_colliding() returns false).

entries.name: RayCast2D.get_collider_rid
entries.summary: Returns the RID of the first object that the ray intersects, or an empty RID if no object is intersecting the ray (i.e. is_colliding() returns false).

entries.name: RayCast2D.get_collider_shape
entries.summary: Returns the shape ID of the first object that the ray intersects, or 0 if no object is intersecting the ray (i.e. is_colliding() returns false).

entries.name: RayCast2D.get_collision_mask_value
entries.summary: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the collision_mask is enabled, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.

entries.name: RayCast2D.get_collision_normal
entries.summary: Returns the normal of the intersecting object's shape at the collision point, or Vector2(0, 0) if the ray starts inside the shape and hit_from_inside is true.

entries.name: RayCast2D.get_collision_point
entries.summary: Returns the collision point at which the ray intersects the closest object, in the global coordinate system.

entries.name: RayCast2D.hit_from_inside
entries.summary: If true, the ray will detect a hit when starting inside shapes. In this case the collision normal will be Vector2(0, 0). Does not affect concave polygon shapes.

entries.name: RayCast2D.is_colliding
entries.summary: Returns whether any object is intersecting with the ray's vector (considering the vector length).

entries.name: RayCast2D.remove_exception
entries.summary: Removes a collision exception so the ray can report collisions with the specified node.

entries.name: RayCast2D.remove_exception_rid
entries.summary: Removes a collision exception so the ray can report collisions with the specified RID.

entries.name: RayCast2D.set_collision_mask_value
entries.summary: Based on value, enables or disables the specified layer in the collision_mask, given a layer_number between 1 and 32.

entries.name: RayCast2D.target_position
entries.summary: The ray's destination point, relative to this raycast's Node2D.position.

entries.name: remap
entries.signature: float remap(value: float, istart: float, istop: float, ostart: float, ostop: float)
entries.summary: Maps a value from range [istart, istop] to [ostart, ostop]. See also lerp() and inverse_lerp(). If value is outside [istart, istop], then the resulting value will also be outside [ostart, ostop].

entries.name: RenderingServer
entries.summary: The RenderingServer singleton.

entries.name: Resource
entries.summary: Base class for serializable objects.

entries.name: Resource._get_rid
entries.summary: Override this method to return a custom RID when get_rid() is called.

entries.name: Resource._reset_state
entries.summary: For resources that store state in non-exported properties, such as via Object._validate_property() or Object._get_property_list(), this method must be implemented to clear them.

entries.name: Resource._set_path_cache
entries.summary: Override this method to execute additional logic after set_path_cache() is called on this object.

entries.name: Resource._setup_local_to_scene
entries.summary: Override this method to customize the newly duplicated resource created from PackedScene.instantiate(), if the original's resource_local_to_scene is set to true.

entries.name: Resource.changed
entries.summary: Emitted when the resource changes, usually when one of its properties is modified. See also emit_changed().

entries.name: Resource.copy_from_resource
entries.summary: Copies the data from resource into this resource. Both resources must share the same class.

entries.name: Resource.duplicate
entries.summary: Duplicates this resource, returning a new resource with its exported or @GlobalScope.PROPERTY_USAGE_STORAGE properties copied from the original.

entries.name: Resource.duplicate_deep
entries.summary: Duplicates this resource, deeply, like duplicate() when passing true, with extra control over how subresources are handled.

entries.name: Resource.emit_changed
entries.summary: Emits the changed signal. This method is called automatically for some built-in resources.

entries.name: Resource.generate_scene_unique_id
entries.summary: Generates a unique identifier for a resource to be contained inside a PackedScene, based on the current date, time, and a random value. The returned string is only composed of letters (a to y) and numbers (0 to 8).

entries.name: Resource.get_id_for_path
entries.summary: From the internal cache for scene-unique IDs, returns the ID of this resource for the scene at path. If there is no entry, an empty string is returned.

entries.name: Resource.get_local_scene
entries.summary: If resource_local_to_scene is set to true and the resource has been loaded from a PackedScene instantiation, returns the root Node of the scene where this resource is used. Otherwise, returns null.

entries.name: Resource.get_rid
entries.summary: Returns the RID of this resource (or an empty RID).

entries.name: Resource.is_built_in
entries.summary: Returns true if the resource is saved on disk as a part of another resource's file.

entries.name: Resource.reset_state
entries.summary: Makes the resource clear its non-exported properties. See also _reset_state(). Useful when implementing a custom resource format by extending ResourceFormatLoader and ResourceFormatSaver.

entries.name: Resource.resource_local_to_scene
entries.summary: If true, the resource is duplicated for each instance of all scenes using it. At run-time, the resource can be modified in one scene without affecting other instances (see PackedScene.instantiate()).

entries.name: Resource.resource_name
entries.summary: An optional name for this resource. When defined, its value is displayed to represent the resource in the Inspector dock. For built-in scripts, the name is displayed as part of the tab name in the script editor.

entries.name: Resource.resource_path
entries.summary: The unique path to this resource. If it has been saved to disk, the value will be its filepath.

entries.name: Resource.resource_scene_unique_id
entries.summary: A unique identifier relative to this resource's scene. If left empty, the ID is automatically generated when this resource is saved inside a PackedScene.

entries.name: Resource.set_id_for_path
entries.summary: In the internal cache for scene-unique IDs, sets the ID of this resource to id for the scene at path. If id is empty, the cache entry for path is cleared.

entries.name: Resource.set_path_cache
entries.summary: Sets the resource's path to path without involving the resource cache. Useful for handling CacheMode values when implementing a custom resource format by extending ResourceFormatLoader and ResourceFormatSaver.

entries.name: Resource.setup_local_to_scene
entries.summary: Deprecated: This method should only be called internally.

entries.name: Resource.setup_local_to_scene_requested
entries.summary: Deprecated: This signal is only emitted when the resource is created. Override _setup_local_to_scene() instead.

entries.name: Resource.take_over_path
entries.summary: Sets the resource_path to path, potentially overriding an existing cache entry for this path. Further attempts to load an overridden resource by path will instead return this resource.

entries.name: ResourceLoader
entries.summary: The ResourceLoader singleton.

entries.name: ResourceSaver
entries.summary: The ResourceSaver singleton.

entries.name: ResourceUID
entries.summary: The ResourceUID singleton.

entries.name: rid_allocate_id
entries.summary: Allocates a unique ID which can be used by the implementation to construct an RID. This is used mainly from native extensions to implement servers.

entries.name: rid_from_int64
entries.summary: Creates an RID from a base. This is used mainly from native extensions to build servers.

entries.name: RigidBody2D
entries.summary: A 2D physics body that is moved by a physics simulation.

entries.name: RigidBody2D._integrate_forces
entries.summary: Called during physics processing, allowing you to read and safely modify the simulation state for the object.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.angular_damp
entries.summary: Damps the body's rotation. By default, the body will use the ProjectSettings.physics/2d/default_angular_damp setting or any value override set by an Area2D the body is in.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.angular_damp_mode
entries.summary: Defines how angular_damp is applied.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.angular_velocity
entries.summary: The body's rotational velocity in radians per second.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.apply_central_force
entries.summary: Applies a directional force without affecting rotation. A force is time dependent and meant to be applied every physics update.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.apply_central_impulse
entries.summary: Applies a directional impulse without affecting rotation.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.apply_force
entries.signature: void apply_force(force: Vector2, position: Vector2 = Vector2(0, 0))
entries.summary: Applies a positioned force to the body. A force is time dependent and meant to be applied every physics update.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.apply_impulse
entries.signature: void apply_impulse(impulse: Vector2, position: Vector2 = Vector2(0, 0))
entries.summary: Applies a positioned impulse to the body.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.apply_torque
entries.summary: Applies a rotational force without affecting position. A force is time dependent and meant to be applied every physics update.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.apply_torque_impulse
entries.summary: Applies a rotational impulse to the body without affecting the position.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.body_entered
entries.summary: Emitted when a collision with another PhysicsBody2D or TileMap occurs. Requires contact_monitor to be set to true and max_contacts_reported to be set high enough to detect all the collisions.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.body_exited
entries.summary: Emitted when the collision with another PhysicsBody2D or TileMap ends. Requires contact_monitor to be set to true and max_contacts_reported to be set high enough to detect all the collisions.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.body_shape_entered
entries.signature: body_shape_entered(body_rid: RID, body: Node, body_shape_index: int, local_shape_index: int)
entries.summary: Emitted when one of this RigidBody2D's Shape2Ds collides with another PhysicsBody2D or TileMap's Shape2Ds.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.body_shape_exited
entries.signature: body_shape_exited(body_rid: RID, body: Node, body_shape_index: int, local_shape_index: int)
entries.summary: Emitted when the collision between one of this RigidBody2D's Shape2Ds and another PhysicsBody2D or TileMap's Shape2Ds ends.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.can_sleep
entries.summary: If true, the body can enter sleep mode when there is no movement. See sleeping.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.center_of_mass
entries.summary: The body's custom center of mass, relative to the body's origin position, when center_of_mass_mode is set to CENTER_OF_MASS_MODE_CUSTOM.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.center_of_mass_mode
entries.summary: Defines the way the body's center of mass is set.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.contact_monitor
entries.summary: If true, the RigidBody2D will emit signals when it collides with another body.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.continuous_cd
entries.summary: Continuous collision detection mode.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.custom_integrator
entries.summary: If true, the standard force integration (like gravity or damping) will be disabled for this body.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.freeze
entries.summary: If true, the body is frozen. Gravity and forces are not applied anymore.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.freeze_mode
entries.summary: The body's freeze mode. Determines the body's behavior when freeze is true.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.get_colliding_bodies
entries.summary: Returns a list of the bodies colliding with this one. Requires contact_monitor to be set to true and max_contacts_reported to be set high enough to detect all the collisions.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.get_contact_count
entries.summary: Returns the number of contacts this body has with other bodies. By default, this returns 0 unless bodies are configured to monitor contacts (see contact_monitor).

entries.name: RigidBody2D.gravity_scale
entries.summary: Multiplies the gravity applied to the body. The body's gravity is calculated from the ProjectSettings.physics/2d/default_gravity project setting and/or any additional gravity vector applied by Area2Ds.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.inertia
entries.summary: The body's moment of inertia. This is like mass, but for rotation: it determines how much torque it takes to rotate the body.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.linear_damp
entries.summary: Damps the body's movement. By default, the body will use the ProjectSettings.physics/2d/default_linear_damp setting or any value override set by an Area2D the body is in.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.linear_damp_mode
entries.summary: Defines how linear_damp is applied.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.linear_velocity
entries.summary: The body's linear velocity in pixels per second. Can be used sporadically, but don't set this every frame, because physics may run in another thread and runs at a different granularity.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.lock_rotation
entries.summary: If true, the body cannot rotate. Gravity and forces only apply linear movement.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.mass
entries.summary: The maximum number of contacts that will be recorded. Requires a value greater than 0 and contact_monitor to be set to true to start to register contacts.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.max_contacts_reported
entries.summary: The maximum number of contacts that will be recorded. Requires a value greater than 0 and contact_monitor to be set to true to start to register contacts.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.physics_material_override
entries.summary: The physics material override for the body.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.set_axis_velocity
entries.summary: Sets the body's velocity on the given axis. The velocity in the given vector axis will be set as the given vector length. This is useful for jumping behavior.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.sleeping
entries.summary: If true, the body will not move and will not calculate forces until woken up by another body through, for example, a collision, or by using the apply_impulse() or apply_force() methods.

entries.name: RigidBody2D.sleeping_state_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when the physics engine changes the body's sleeping state.

entries.name: rotate_toward
entries.signature: float rotate_toward(from: float, to: float, delta: float)
entries.summary: Rotates from toward to by the delta amount. Will not go past to.

entries.name: round
entries.summary: Rounds x to the nearest whole number, with halfway cases rounded away from 0. Supported types: int, float, Vector2, Vector2i, Vector3, Vector3i, Vector4, Vector4i.

entries.name: roundf
entries.summary: Rounds x to the nearest whole number, with halfway cases rounded away from 0.

entries.name: roundi
entries.summary: Rounds x to the nearest whole number, with halfway cases rounded away from 0.

entries.name: seed
entries.summary: Sets the seed for the random number generator to base. Setting the seed manually can ensure consistent, repeatable results for most random functions.

entries.name: sign
entries.summary: Returns the same type of Variant as x, with -1 for negative values, 1 for positive values, and 0 for zeros. For nan values it returns 0.

entries.name: signf
entries.summary: Returns -1.0 if x is negative, 1.0 if x is positive, and 0.0 if x is zero. For nan values of x it returns 0.0.

entries.name: signi
entries.summary: Returns -1 if x is negative, 1 if x is positive, and 0 if x is zero.

entries.name: sin
entries.summary: Returns the sine of angle angle_rad in radians.

entries.name: sinh
entries.summary: Returns the hyperbolic sine of x.

entries.name: smoothstep
entries.signature: float smoothstep(from: float, to: float, x: float)
entries.summary: Returns a smooth cubic Hermite interpolation between 0 and 1.

entries.name: snapped
entries.summary: Returns the multiple of step that is the closest to x. This can also be used to round a floating-point number to an arbitrary number of decimals.

entries.name: snappedf
entries.summary: Returns the multiple of step that is the closest to x. This can also be used to round a floating-point number to an arbitrary number of decimals.

entries.name: snappedi
entries.summary: Returns the multiple of step that is the closest to x.

entries.name: Sprite2D
entries.summary: General-purpose sprite node.

entries.name: Sprite2D.centered
entries.summary: If true, texture is centered.

entries.name: Sprite2D.flip_h
entries.summary: If true, texture is flipped horizontally.

entries.name: Sprite2D.flip_v
entries.summary: If true, texture is flipped vertically.

entries.name: Sprite2D.frame
entries.summary: Current frame to display from sprite sheet. hframes or vframes must be greater than 1.

entries.name: Sprite2D.frame_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when the frame changes.

entries.name: Sprite2D.frame_coords
entries.summary: Coordinates of the frame to display from sprite sheet. This is as an alias for the frame property. hframes or vframes must be greater than 1.

entries.name: Sprite2D.get_rect
entries.summary: Returns a Rect2 representing the Sprite2D's boundary in local coordinates.

entries.name: Sprite2D.hframes
entries.summary: The number of columns in the sprite sheet. When this property is changed, frame is adjusted so that the same visual frame is maintained (same row and column). If that's impossible, frame is reset to 0.

entries.name: Sprite2D.is_pixel_opaque
entries.summary: Returns true if the pixel at the given position is opaque, false otherwise. Also returns false if the given position is out of bounds or this sprite's texture is null. pos is in local coordinates.

entries.name: Sprite2D.offset
entries.summary: The texture's drawing offset.

entries.name: Sprite2D.region_enabled
entries.summary: If true, texture is cut from a larger atlas texture. See region_rect.

entries.name: Sprite2D.region_filter_clip_enabled
entries.summary: If true, the area outside of the region_rect is clipped to avoid bleeding of the surrounding texture pixels. region_enabled must be true.

entries.name: Sprite2D.region_rect
entries.summary: The region of the atlas texture to display. region_enabled must be true.

entries.name: Sprite2D.texture
entries.summary: Texture2D object to draw.

entries.name: Sprite2D.texture_changed
entries.summary: Emitted when the texture changes.

entries.name: Sprite2D.vframes
entries.summary: The number of rows in the sprite sheet. When this property is changed, frame is adjusted so that the same visual frame is maintained (same row and column). If that's impossible, frame is reset to 0.

entries.name: sqrt
entries.summary: Returns the square root of x, where x is a non-negative number.

entries.name: step_decimals
entries.summary: Returns the position of the first non-zero digit, after the decimal point. Note that the maximum return value is 10, which is a design decision in the implementation.

entries.name: str
entries.summary: Converts one or more arguments of any Variant type to a String in the best way possible.

entries.name: str_to_var
entries.summary: Converts a formatted string that was returned by var_to_str() to the original Variant.

entries.name: tan
entries.summary: Returns the tangent of angle angle_rad in radians.

entries.name: tanh
entries.summary: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of x.

entries.name: TextServerManager
entries.summary: The TextServerManager singleton.

entries.name: ThemeDB
entries.summary: The ThemeDB singleton.

entries.name: TileMapLayer
entries.summary: Node for 2D tile-based maps.

entries.name: TileMapLayer._tile_data_runtime_update
entries.summary: Called with a TileData object about to be used internally by the TileMapLayer, allowing its modification at runtime.

entries.name: TileMapLayer._update_cells
entries.summary: Called when this TileMapLayer's cells need an internal update. This update may be caused from individual cells being modified or by a change in the tile_set (causing all cells to be queued for an update).

entries.name: TileMapLayer._use_tile_data_runtime_update
entries.summary: Should return true if the tile at coordinates coords requires a runtime update.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.changed
entries.summary: Emitted when this TileMapLayer's properties changes. This includes modified cells, properties, or changes made to its assigned TileSet.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.clear
entries.summary: Erases the cell at coordinates coords.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.collision_enabled
entries.summary: Enable or disable collisions.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.collision_visibility_mode
entries.summary: Show or hide the TileMapLayer's collision shapes. If set to DEBUG_VISIBILITY_MODE_DEFAULT, this depends on the show collision debug settings.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.enabled
entries.summary: If false, disables this TileMapLayer completely (rendering, collision, navigation, scene tiles, etc.)

entries.name: TileMapLayer.erase_cell
entries.summary: Erases the cell at coordinates coords.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.fix_invalid_tiles
entries.summary: Clears cells containing tiles that do not exist in the tile_set.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.get_cell_alternative_tile
entries.summary: Returns the tile alternative ID of the cell at coordinates coords.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.get_cell_atlas_coords
entries.summary: Returns the tile atlas coordinates ID of the cell at coordinates coords. Returns Vector2i(-1, -1) if the cell does not exist.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.get_cell_source_id
entries.summary: Returns the tile source ID of the cell at coordinates coords. Returns -1 if the cell does not exist.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.get_cell_tile_data
entries.summary: Returns the TileData object associated with the given cell, or null if the cell does not exist or is not a TileSetAtlasSource.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.get_coords_for_body_rid
entries.summary: Returns the coordinates of the physics quadrant (see physics_quadrant_size) for given physics body RID. Such an RID can be retrieved from KinematicCollision2D.get_collider_rid(), when colliding with a tile.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.get_navigation_map
entries.summary: Returns the RID of the NavigationServer2D navigation used by this TileMapLayer.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.get_neighbor_cell
entries.signature: Vector2i get_neighbor_cell(coords: Vector2i, neighbor: CellNeighbor) const
entries.summary: Returns the neighboring cell to the one at coordinates coords, identified by the neighbor direction. This method takes into account the different layouts a TileMap can take.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.get_pattern
entries.summary: Creates and returns a new TileMapPattern from the given array of cells. See also set_pattern().

entries.name: TileMapLayer.get_surrounding_cells
entries.summary: Returns the list of all neighboring cells to the one at coords. Any neighboring cell is one that is touching edges, so for a square cell 4 cells would be returned, for a hexagon 6 cells are returned.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.get_used_cells
entries.summary: Returns a Vector2i array with the positions of all cells containing a tile.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.get_used_cells_by_id
entries.signature: Array[Vector2i] get_used_cells_by_id(source_id: int = -1, atlas_coords: Vector2i = Vector2i(-1, -1), alternative_tile: int = -1) const
entries.summary: Returns a Vector2i array with the positions of all cells containing a tile. Tiles may be filtered according to their source (source_id), their atlas coordinates (atlas_coords), or alternative id (alternative_tile).

entries.name: TileMapLayer.get_used_rect
entries.summary: Returns a rectangle enclosing the used (non-empty) tiles of the map.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.has_body_rid
entries.summary: Returns whether the provided body RID belongs to one of this TileMapLayer's cells.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.is_cell_flipped_h
entries.summary: Returns true if the cell at coordinates coords is flipped horizontally. The result is valid only for atlas sources.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.is_cell_flipped_v
entries.summary: Returns true if the cell at coordinates coords is flipped vertically. The result is valid only for atlas sources.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.is_cell_transposed
entries.summary: Returns true if the cell at coordinates coords is transposed. The result is valid only for atlas sources.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.local_to_map
entries.summary: Returns the map coordinates of the cell containing the given local_position. If local_position is in global coordinates, consider using Node2D.to_local() before passing it to this method. See also map_to_local().

entries.name: TileMapLayer.map_pattern
entries.signature: Vector2i map_pattern(position_in_tilemap: Vector2i, coords_in_pattern: Vector2i, pattern: TileMapPattern)
entries.summary: Returns for the given coordinates coords_in_pattern in a TileMapPattern the corresponding cell coordinates if the pattern was pasted at the position_in_tilemap coordinates (see set_pattern()).

entries.name: TileMapLayer.map_to_local
entries.summary: Returns the centered position of a cell in the TileMapLayer's local coordinate space. To convert the returned value into global coordinates, use Node2D.to_global(). See also local_to_map().

entries.name: TileMapLayer.navigation_enabled
entries.summary: If true, navigation regions are enabled.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.navigation_visibility_mode
entries.summary: Show or hide the TileMapLayer's navigation meshes. If set to DEBUG_VISIBILITY_MODE_DEFAULT, this depends on the show navigation debug settings.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.notify_runtime_tile_data_update
entries.summary: Notifies the TileMapLayer node that calls to _use_tile_data_runtime_update() or _tile_data_runtime_update() will lead to different results. This will thus trigger a TileMapLayer update.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.occlusion_enabled
entries.summary: Enable or disable light occlusion.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.physics_quadrant_size
entries.summary: The TileMapLayer's physics quadrant size.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.rendering_quadrant_size
entries.summary: The TileMapLayer's rendering quadrant size.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.set_cell
entries.signature: void set_cell(coords: Vector2i, source_id: int = -1, atlas_coords: Vector2i = Vector2i(-1, -1), alternative_tile: int = 0)
entries.summary: Sets the tile identifiers for the cell at coordinates coords. Each tile of the TileSet is identified using three parts:

entries.name: TileMapLayer.set_cells_terrain_connect
entries.signature: void set_cells_terrain_connect(cells: Array[Vector2i], terrain_set: int, terrain: int, ignore_empty_terrains: bool = true)
entries.summary: Update all the cells in the cells coordinates array so that they use the given terrain for the given terrain_set.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.set_cells_terrain_path
entries.signature: void set_cells_terrain_path(path: Array[Vector2i], terrain_set: int, terrain: int, ignore_empty_terrains: bool = true)
entries.summary: Update all the cells in the path coordinates array so that they use the given terrain for the given terrain_set. The function will also connect two successive cell in the path with the same terrain.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.set_navigation_map
entries.summary: Sets a custom map as a NavigationServer2D navigation map. If not set, uses the default World2D navigation map instead.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.set_pattern
entries.summary: Pastes the TileMapPattern at the given position in the tile map. See also get_pattern().

entries.name: TileMapLayer.tile_map_data
entries.summary: The raw tile map data as a byte array.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.tile_set
entries.summary: The TileSet used by this layer. The textures, collisions, and additional behavior of all available tiles are stored here.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.update_internals
entries.summary: Triggers a direct update of the TileMapLayer. Usually, calling this function is not needed, as TileMapLayer node updates automatically when one of its properties or cells is modified.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.use_kinematic_bodies
entries.summary: If true, this TileMapLayer collision shapes will be instantiated as kinematic bodies. This can be needed for moving TileMapLayer nodes (i.e. moving platforms).

entries.name: TileMapLayer.x_draw_order_reversed
entries.summary: If CanvasItem.y_sort_enabled is enabled, setting this to true will reverse the order the tiles are drawn on the X-axis.

entries.name: TileMapLayer.y_sort_origin
entries.summary: This Y-sort origin value is added to each tile's Y-sort origin value. This allows, for example, to fake a different height level. This can be useful for top-down view games.

entries.name: Time
entries.summary: The TranslationServer singleton.

entries.name: Timer
entries.summary: The Timer node is a countdown timer and is the simplest way to handle time-based logic in the engine. When a timer reaches the end of its wait_time, it will emit the timeout signal.

entries.name: Timer.autostart
entries.summary: If true, the timer will start immediately when it enters the scene tree.

entries.name: Timer.ignore_time_scale
entries.summary: If true, the timer will ignore Engine.time_scale and update with the real, elapsed time.

entries.name: Timer.is_stopped
entries.summary: Returns true if the timer is stopped or has not started.

entries.name: Timer.one_shot
entries.summary: If true, the timer will stop after reaching the end. Otherwise, as by default, the timer will automatically restart.

entries.name: Timer.paused
entries.summary: If true, the timer is paused. A paused timer does not process until this property is set back to false, even when start() is called. See also stop().

entries.name: Timer.process_callback
entries.summary: Specifies when the timer is updated during the main loop.

entries.name: Timer.start
entries.summary: Starts the timer, or resets the timer if it was started already. Fails if the timer is not inside the scene tree. If time_sec is greater than 0, this value is used for the wait_time.

entries.name: Timer.stop
entries.summary: Stops the timer. See also paused. Unlike start(), this can safely be called if the timer is not inside the scene tree.

entries.name: Timer.time_left
entries.summary: The timer's remaining time in seconds. This is always 0 if the timer is stopped.

entries.name: Timer.timeout
entries.summary: Emitted when the timer reaches the end.

entries.name: Timer.wait_time
entries.summary: The time required for the timer to end, in seconds. This property can also be set every time start() is called.

entries.name: TranslationServer
entries.summary: The TranslationServer singleton.

entries.name: type_convert
entries.summary: Converts the given variant to the given type, using the Variant.Type values.

entries.name: type_exists
entries.summary: Deprecated: Use ClassDB.class_exists() instead.

entries.name: type_string
entries.summary: Returns a human-readable name of the given type, using the Variant.Type values.

entries.name: typeof
entries.summary: Returns the internal type of the given variable, using the Variant.Type values.

entries.name: var_to_bytes
entries.summary: Encodes a Variant value to a byte array, without encoding objects. Deserialization can be done with bytes_to_var().

entries.name: var_to_bytes_with_objects
entries.summary: Encodes a Variant value to a byte array. Encoding objects is allowed (and can potentially include executable code). Deserialization can be done with bytes_to_var_with_objects().

entries.name: var_to_str
entries.summary: Converts a Variant variable to a formatted String that can then be parsed using str_to_var().

entries.name: weakref
entries.summary: Returns a WeakRef instance holding a weak reference to obj. Returns an empty WeakRef instance if obj is null. Prints an error and returns null if obj is neither Object-derived nor null.

entries.name: WorkerThreadPool
entries.summary: The WorkerThreadPool singleton.

entries.name: wrap
entries.signature: Variant wrap(value: Variant, min: Variant, max: Variant)
entries.summary: Wraps the Variant value between min and max. min is inclusive while max is exclusive. This can be used for creating loop-like behavior or infinite surfaces.

entries.name: wrapf
entries.signature: float wrapf(value: float, min: float, max: float)
entries.summary: Wraps the float value between min and max. min is inclusive while max is exclusive. This can be used for creating loop-like behavior or infinite surfaces.

entries.name: wrapi
entries.signature: int wrapi(value: int, min: int, max: int)
entries.summary: Wraps the integer value between min and max. min is inclusive while max is exclusive. This can be used for creating loop-like behavior or infinite surfaces.

entries.name: XRServer
entries.summary: The XRServer singleton.
